Our values are the basis on which we build strong relationships with our clients, our investors and each other. They are the foundation of our business and integral to our continued ability to pioneer success.

Build trust – We behave and act in ways that earn trust

Embrace “different” – We embrace new ideas and constantly strive to discover new ways of doing things

# Senior Endpoint & Security Engineer, London office

Information Technology GroupUK-London Office

Apply Now

8x8 connects our customers and teams globally, empowering CX leaders with performance and insights to make smarter decisions, delight customers, and drive lasting business impact.

At 8x8 we',re reimagining how work gets done, and AI is at the centre of that. Were looking for a **Sr. Endpoint &Security Engineer, based full-time in our London office**, to own our endpoint security stack globally while also being the on-site technical presence for our London team.

This is a global engineering + local IT Site Support role. Your time will be split roughly evenly between two focuses:  
**• Engineering focus (global scope):** You are the SME and service owner for endpoint security, MDM, ZeroTrust access, work app isolation, DLP, and endpoint hardening across the enterprise. You own the how, why, strategy, processes, measurement, and Tier 3/4 support for these services.  
**• Site IT Support (London office)**: You are the walk-up technical presence for our London office. You handle  
device provisioning, AV, asset management, and general on-site support.  
If you like the idea of setting the endpoint security direction for a 2,000-person global company while also being the person a colleague can walk up to when their laptop won't behave, this role was written for you.

**What You' ll Do:**

**Your mission:** Research, select, deploy, and operationalize the tooling that will carry us forward across MDM, work app isolation, Zero Trust access, DLP, and device hardening.

**Endpoint Security Engineering (Global)**  
• Own MDM strategy and configuration across MacOS and Windows (corporate endpoints) as well as iOS and Android (BYOD). Includes compliance baselines, hardening, and self-service app delivery.  
• Own the work app isolation and BYOD data-containment model. You'll evaluate, select, deploy, optimize, and support the chosen platform.  
• Own the ZTNA client rollout and endpoint compliance posture as a real gate for network access.  
• Own endpoint security policy: DLP, patching cadence, OS hardening, application control, USB and removable media controls.  
• Own laptop backup coverage, policy, and periodic recovery testing.  
• Partner with 8x8's Security team on EDR/XDR endpoint tuning and incident triage  
• Produce SOC 2 and ISO 27001 evidence for endpoint controls during audit cycles

**London Site Support**  
• Provide walk-up and desk-side support for London office employees.  
• Own device provisioning at the London office: new-hire builds, onboarding training, refresh, and secure retirement.  
• Own AV and meeting-room technology checks in the London office.  
• Own local asset management: receiving, tagging, stock control, and end-of-life disposal in line with policy.  
• Provide on-site technical support for events and executive visits hosted in the London office.  
• Coordinate with other Site Technical Leads on site coverage, escalations, and cross-office standards.

**AI-Augmented Way of Working**  
• Use 8x8's approved AI tools (Google Gemini, Claude, AI Studio) to accelerate your own work, from policy documentation to telemetry analysis to script drafting.  
• Identify AI-driven automation opportunities across endpoint operations.  
• Share what works with the broader IT team and help colleagues build their own AI fluency.

**What We're Looking For:**

**Required**  
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on  
experience.  
• Minimum 6 years experience in endpoint engineering or endpoint security, with clear senior-level ownership in recent roles.  
• Hands-on MDM experience at scale (1,000+ devices) using Addigy, Jamf, Intune, or equivalent  
• Endpoint security policy design experience across DLP, patching, OS hardening, and application control.  
• Working knowledge of EDR/XDR platforms (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or Microsoft Defender for  
Endpoint), including deployment, tuning, and incident triage.  
• Working knowledge of ZTNA and Zero Trust access. You can explain the endpoint-to-identity policy chain in  
plain terms.  
• Genuine openness and enthusiasm for AI tools. We will grow you into our AI-first approach; you bring the  
curiosity.  
• Customer service instinct. You're the person a stressed colleague walks up to. You triage calmly, solve what you can, and route what you can't.  
• The ability to work and think independently, take initiative, and be effective with or without detailed work direction.  
• Ability to lift and move equipment weighing up to 20 kg (approx. 45 lb) around the London office as part of provisioning, AV, and refresh work.

**Preferred**  
• Hands-on experience with work app isolation or BYOD platforms (Venn Blue Border, Ivanti / MobileIron, or  
comparable) and data-containment policy design.  
• Familiarity with Okta and Microsoft Entra ID sufficient to partner with our IAM engineers on conditional  
access.  
• Prior experience producing SOC 2 or ISO 27001 evidence for endpoint controls.  
• Experience with laptop backup platforms (Druva or comparable) and periodic recovery testing.  
• Corporate AV and meeting-room experience (Zoom Rooms, Google Meet Series One, Poly, Logitech)  
sufficient that you know AV troubleshooting is usually a cable, not a mystery.

**Why 8x8?**  
We're a Silicon Valley-founded, Nasdaq-listed company powering customer experience for organisations around the world, and we're doing it with an increasingly AI-native approach. Internal IT at 8x8 isn't a back-office function. We shape how the business operates, we experiment with technology, and we lead from the front.  
You'll have direct access to 8x8's approved AI tool stack, including Google Gemini Workspace and Claude.ai Enterprise, and the latitude to use them meaningfully in your day-to-day work and in the solutions you build for the business.

You will directly influence the endpoint security posture that every 8x8 employee experiences every day. If you want a role where your curiosity about AI and endpoint security is an asset, not a side interest, we'd love to hear from you.

The Senior Technical Manager manages day-to-day technical delivery across ALM’s technical department. Sitting between the Head of Technical and the wider technical team, the role turns departmental priorities into controlled execution.

Reports to: Head of Technical

Direct Reports: Technical Manager, Airworthiness Review Engineers, Technical Coordinator

* Own the day-to-day operation and delivery rhythm of the technical department.

* Run the weekly technical workflow meeting and maintain visibility of all active technical workstreams.

* Allocate work across the Technical Manager, Airworthiness / Technical Review Engineers and Technical Coordinator.

* Ensure material projects have clear scope, milestones, supplier responsibilities, internal owners, decision points and reporting cadence.

* Coach and develop Airworthiness / Technical Review Engineers toward future Technical Manager capability.

* Ensure the Technical Coordinator maintains effective meeting discipline, document control, workflow tracking, action logs, project administration and reporting support.

* Act as deputy operational lead for the department during Head of Technical travel, leave or senior external commitments.

#### Expected Outputs

* Weekly technical workflow review and live department control tracker.

* Clear allocation of work by owner, due date and escalation route.

* Monthly project delivery/status summary.

* Resource and workload view across the department.

* Supplier performance visibility and escalation log.

* Coaching and development plans for the technical team.

#### Cover / Redundancy

* Provides vertical redundancy for the Head of Technical on operational department control.

* Can step down into Technical Manager workstreams where critical cover is needed.

* Ensures the Technical Manager, Engineers and Coordinator can support each other without work stalling when an individual is absent.

The Airworthiness Review Engineer undertakes defined technical, airworthiness, physical inspection and records review activities for ALM and third-party Client Aircraft portfolios. The role provides the evidence base that enables Technical Managers to manage transitions, acquisitions, returns, inspections, asset surveillance and technical projects.

#### Reporting Line

Reports to: Senior Technical Manager

Direct Reports: n/a

## Clinical Seating Engineer

**Active Design** **Role: Clinical Seating Engineer  
 Benefits: Free on-site parking, Legal and General pension contributions, 27 days annual leave with increase to 29 and 33 days with continuous service, paid sick leave with continuous service, Employee Assistant programme**

Active Design is leading manufacturer of wheelchair special seating products and clinical seating services. The company has been involved in the design, development and manufacturer of postural management equipment for over 30 years. Our products are manufactured at our factory in Aston, Birmingham using a wide range of production techniques.

**What we are looking for:**

We are seeking to recruit an enthusiastic Clinical Seating Engineer that will prescribe seating systems which are shaped individually to service users, most of whom will have complex needs, based on clinical data gathered at assessment and the response of the person to the supporting surface.  They will work in conjunction with the wheelchair service clinicians to develop optimised support for the individual.  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manipulating the material directly to the service user
* Capturing a shape using vacuum consolidation bead bags
* Manufacturing a bespoke tubular framework to support the cellular structure and interfacing this to wheelchair bases
* Adapting/modifying equipment to meet specific needs
* Creating bespoke solutions where off-the-shelf equipment cannot be obtained to meet the person’s needs
* Handing over the completed system to the service user
* Making further adjustments to the system over time to allow for growth or changing need.

The role requires integration of clinical and technical knowledge with practical application, taking account of the service user’s functional needs, which often conflict with their postural requirements, and the fact that people can present differently on different days and that factors beyond their control have an influence on their ability to tolerate/respond to a seating system.

Whilst responsibility for the individual’s episode of care lies with the local clinician, the post holder is responsible for ensuring that the needs of the individual are met in an effective and safe manner.  As an autonomous practitioner you will:

1. Be managed, rather than supervised; results/outcomes are assessed at agreed intervals through clinical supervision; this will be guided by precedent and policy
2. Provide high quality, service user focused assessment and prescription of wheelchair seating, also including manual wheelchairs, powered wheelchairs and buggies
3. Work within professional and regulatory standards, and clinical/technical guidelines, promoting best practice and undertaking all aspects of clinical and technical duties
4. Provide specialist clinical and technical advice to other members of the team and contribute to the development of clinical and technical services
5. Possess expertise within the specialism of wheelchair services, underpinned by developed clinical and technical theoretical knowledge and experience
6. Regularly perform development work in relation to service user specific clinical/technical requirements
7. Plan and deliver training sessions for health and social care professionals

The job holder will work in a variety of settings including clinics, community centres, and service users’ homes according to service requirements.  In addition, they will participate in clinical governance activity, including CPD and developing and implementing quality improvements within the service.

We are looking for someone to work 40 hours per week Monday to Thursday between 8am to 5pm with a half hour unpaid lunch break and 2 x 15-minute breaks (paid) and Fridays 7am – 1pm. This role can be home based but with the understanding that requirement to attend clinics around the South and South East region and be out in the community plays a big part of the role and therefore you must also hold a valid UK driving license with no more then 6 points on.

Remote - EMEA

**Who We Are:**

**Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure**for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.  
  
Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.  
  
Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.  
  
**Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.**  
  
**Our Team Members:**

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!  
  
We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

## **Your Role**

As Senior Insider & Data Risk Analyst, you will own insider risk investigations and help mature Alpaca's Insider Risk Management Program and Data Loss Prevention capabilities. You will triage and investigate signals across people, devices, identity, and data movement, apply risk tiering and escalation standards, and partner with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, and IT on sensitive cases involving departures, policy violations, and data misuse.

This role sits at the intersection of insider risk, data protection, privacy, and financial services. Reporting to the Cyber GRC Lead, you will serve as Security's escalation point for insider and data loss cases affecting trading systems, customer data, and proprietary information. This is a practical senior individual contributor role for someone experienced, discreet, and highly organized who can own investigation workflows, translate risk into clear language for leadership, and build durable programs and processes. Prior experience in a regulated or financial services environment is a strong plus.

Things You Get To Do

* Own insider risk investigations from triage through closure, including case timelines, containment, escalation, and documented determinations and lessons learned
* Mature Alpaca's Insider Risk Management Program, including case management processes, risk tiering, and repeatable workflows
* Operate and tune Data Loss Prevention tooling across multiple environments and endpoints, refining rulesets to improve signal and reduce false positives
* Mature data classification and align DLP controls to sensitivity levels
* Investigate potential data exfiltration, misuse, and policy violations; build and tune detections and monitoring
* Investigate misuse and exfiltration risk across source code, Google, AWS, Azure, third party apps, Slack, and trading and platform system access
* Partner with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, and IT on sensitive cases (departures, policy violations, data mishandling) with discretion and care
* Assess risk from unauthorized AI/agentic tooling and sensitive data exposure through approved and unsanctioned AI tooling
* Leverage Agentic AI to continue maturation of Insider risk program
* Lead insider and data risk assessments and maintain risk registers
* Support internal and external audits and regulatory requirements
* Contribute insider risk and data handling content to the security awareness and training program
* Serve as the insider risk escalation point for the Security team and mentor others on investigations and casework
* Monitor developments in insider risk, data protection, privacy, and financial services regulation.

## **Who You Are (Must Haves)**

* Highly organized with strong attention to detail; comfortable in a fast paced, high demand, distributed environment
* 4+ years in insider risk, DLP operations, digital forensics, or security investigations, including hands on case management on sensitive personnel matters
* Hands on experience leading investigations and case management with discretion, integrity, and sound judgment on sensitive personnel matters
* Hands-on experience operating DLP in SaaS and endpoint environments and tuning rules to improve signal quality
* Experience with workflow automation, AI, or SOAR platforms for alert triage and case orchestration
* Solid understanding of data classification and data governance
* Working knowledge of SIEM and log analysis (e.g., ELK/Elastic, Splunk) to support investigations
* Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and privacy regulations (GDPR, APPI)
* Strong written communication, able to draft clear investigation reports, case documentation, and executive summaries
* High integrity and discretion when handling confidential and sensitive information
* Ability to work across People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, and IT

## **Who You Might Be (Nice to Haves)**

* Academic background, personal interest, or real world experience in fintech, financial services, or trading platforms
* Digital forensics or eDiscovery experience
* Experience with UEBA or insider risk detection platforms
* Scripting or automation for detections and data analysis (e.g., Python, SQL)
* Experience with major cloud platforms
* Experience supporting or observing SOC 2, ISO 27001, or regulatory audits
* Certifications such as GCFA, GCFE, CISSP, CISM, CIPP, CFE, or similar
* Interest in AI related data risk (e.g., data exposure through AI tools) and using AI tooling to work more efficiently
* Familiarity with financial services regulatory expectations (e.g., SEC/FINRA, broker dealer controls) and multi jurisdiction privacy requirements
* Experience in security operations or incident response

* Health Benefits

# Sr. Robotics Manager, Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation, Design & Deployment

Job ID: 10495598 | Amazon UK Services Ltd. - A10

Apply now

## Description

Reinvent how the world's largest robotics network gets deployed.  
Amazon is seeking a Senior Manager for our Robotics Delivery, Packaging & Innovation to define and lead the Design for Deployment (DfD) technical deep-dive, and associated implementation strategy, across our global robotics fulfillment network. This is a founding, build-it-from-scratch role: you will define what "deployable" means for every robotics technology Amazon ships, and your decisions will shape how thousands of implementations happen across six continents.  
  
Amazon's culture encourages an entrepreneurial approach and expects engineers and managers alike to take a high level of ownership in solving complex problems in a fast-paced environment.  
  
The role could be based in Vercelli or alternatively in London or Luxembourg with ~60% travel across Europe and internationally for design reviews and field validation activities.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
This is a hands-on, boots-on-the-ground technical role. In the role you will:  
  
- Serve as the organization's DfD technical authority, overview engineering drawings, mechatronic designs, and controls architectures, to embed quantified deployment requirements into engineering design, providing a single consolidated deployment voice and force multiplying deployment teams across multiple technology programs.  
- Drive technically complex DfD programs: determining feasibility of infrastructure builds at scale, identifying when deployment issues stem from technical design decisions, and driving engineering to design to a defined deployment bar (mechanical, electrical, controls, layout, system integration and mechatronic domains).  
- Advise VPs and the broader Robotics leadership on strategy, governance mechanisms and trade-offs, drive clarity where the problem itself may be undefined, optimize cross-organizational structures that enable teams to deliver independently.  
- Coach deployment teams to engage in engineering design reviews, design decisions, and feed field learnings back to product teams systematically. You'll mentor deployment engineers and TiPMs, sharing DfD best practices and technical deep-dive methods and helping managers guide career growth.  
- Define and own the end-to-end DfD strategy across all technology programs, ensuring every program has a quantified deployment bar (installation duration, workforce management, safety risk, cost per unit install).  
- Force multiply deployment teams by creating, optimizing, and driving adoption of DfD mechanisms that enable teams to operate independently and at scale.  
- Decompose complex deployment design problems into straightforward infrastructure solutions; define DfD Core Tenets and quantified requirements that engineering designs to across all solutions.  
- Establish and evangelize the principle that deployment data is influence currency: creating systems and expectations for teams to document and quantify deployment pain caused by design decisions, replacing anecdotal feedback with systematic, data-driven design influence.  
- Remediate critical and/or endemic deployment design problems; make trade-offs between business opportunity, resources, and sustainability with a long-term perspective.  
- Identify endemic deployment problems, such as recurring modularity constraints, cable management challenges, or commissioning inefficiencies, diagnosing them and drive engineering to eliminate them at the source rather than compensating in the field.   
- Drive measurable DfD outcomes and metrics, such as reduction in deployment duration, cost per unit, first-time installation success rate.  
  
A day in the life  
As a Sr. Manager, you will be the person that engineers and design owners come to for the deployment verdict. Your work will have global impact across multiple organizational goals and program-related metrics.  
  
- You'll operate with complete independence in an area where business and infrastructure build strategy may not yet be defined.  
- You will spend real time on the floor, next to the machines and the teams installing them, which is exactly where this role earns its credibility and its impact.  
- You'll partner with other Robotics teams to validate design improvements and quantify realized savings against targets.  
- You'll drive the cultural shift across the organization: coaching teams to stop absorbing complexity and start preventing it, building confidence in deployment engineers to challenge design decisions with data, and establishing new norms where field intelligence flows systematically back to product teams.  
  
No two days will be the same in our fast-paced environment, offering opportunities for strategic impact as part of a collaborative, high-performing team.  
  
About the team  
Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation is a diverse and multi-talented team with a proven track record of overcoming challenging technical problems to deliver Amazon’s leading-edge robotics technologies in its fulfillment, transportation, and delivery network across the world. Our high-performing team blends engineering know-how, problem solving, curiosity, innovation, leadership, and effective communication to deliver positive results for our customers.

## Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field  
- Experience mentoring or training the engineering community on complex technical issues  
- Experience in a technical program management in the hardware/mechatronic development, deployment engineering domain or equivalent  
- Technical depth in mechanical, electrical, controls, and mechatronic designs  
- Experience defining and owning strategies or equivalent scalable deployment-readiness frameworks.  
- Experience determining feasibility of infrastructure builds at scale for technical products and decomposing complex processes into infrastructure solutions.  
- Experience advising VP organizations and senior leaders on deployment strategy, technical trade-offs, and infrastructure build prioritization.  
- Experience with written communication including authoring narratives presenting to leadership.

## Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree or above in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or related STEM field  
- Knowledge of Kaizen and Lean methodology techniques  
- project management certification such as PMP, Scrum, or other Agile certification  
- Experience with robotic deployments in warehouse or fulfillment environments across multiple countries, adapting processes across regulatory and operational environments.

Connection to our work, our customers, our colleagues and our community that creates a working environment that fosters openness, collaboration and creativity.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated **DevOps/SRE Tech Lead** to join our dynamic engineering team. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of cloud technologies, a strong technical background and a passion for driving operational excellence. As a Tech Lead, you will not only mentor and guide our DevOps engineers but also participate in architectural and key decision-making forums regarding our infrastructure and application development processes ensuring a focus is always on the reliability of our systems and centered on positive customer experience. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of our systems and infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Build SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs:** Partner with development and business teams to define indicators and objectives that reflect real customer experience
* **Incident Response:** Lead through complex incidents and continuously improve how quickly we detect, diagnose, and resolve issues — sharpening alerting, tooling, and on-call practices to shorten MTTD and MTTR over time.
* **Evolve Monitoring and Observability Stack:** Consistently improve the observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry) with a customer-centric lens leading our operations to be more effective
* **Drive RCAs and Postmortems:** Run blameless root cause analyses and postmortems that turn incidents into durable improvements, closing the developer and operations loop
* **High Availability & Performance:** Ensure platform availability and responsiveness meet customer expectations. Identify and remove performance bottlenecks before they impact customer
* **AI for Operations:** Apply AI/LLM capabilities to incident triage, log/trace analysis, runbook execution, and anomaly detection to shorten MTTR and reduce on-call load.
* **Optimization for Cost:** Right-size workloads, eliminate waste, and design for cost-efficient scaling across our cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and container infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes).

* **Toil Reduction:** Build automated processes to reduce toil within SRE, such as remediation for known failure modes so the platform heals itself where possible, escalating to humans only when judgement is genuinely required.
* **Architectural Oversight:** Participate in architectural design and decision-making processes, ensuring that design choices align with organizational goals and best practices.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* **High-Signal Alerting:** Alerts are accurate and actionable — when something fires, it matters, and the team trusts it. Noise is actively driven down rather than tolerated.
* **Fewer Production Incidents:** The number and severity of customer-impacting incidents trend down over time, as recurring failure modes are addressed at the root rather than worked around.
* **Tight Product–SRE Feedback Loop:** Continuous, two-way feedback between product engineering and SRE — reliability concerns shape what gets built, and operational learnings flow back into product decisions.
* **Reduced Toil:** Engineers spend less time on repetitive operational work and more time on improvements that compound — measured by what gets automated, eliminated, or self-healed away.

**Qualifications:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* **Experience:**5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or related fields, with at least 2 years in a leadership or mentoring role.
* **Cloud Technologies:** Deep understanding of cloud providers (Azure, AWS, GCP) and hands-on experience with cloud architecture.
* **Architectural Design:** Proven experience in providing architectural oversight, with a strong ability to make informed decisions that drive system performance and scalability.
* **Containerization:** Proven experience with container orchestration platforms, particularly Kubernetes.
* **Scripting:** Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python or Bash.
* **Monitoring and Logging:** Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and the Grafana stack.
* **Automation Tools:** Experience with automation tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Chef.
* **Soft Skills:** Strong leadership qualities, excellent communication skills, and a collaborative mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and relevant tools (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, etc.).
* Kubernetes certification (CKA, CKAD) and/or cloud certifications (Azure, AWS, GCP) are highly desirable.
* Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards in cloud environments.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools.

## About the role

At Anterior, Clinical Solutions Architects bring cutting-edge AI to life in the messy real world of payer operations. The Frontier is where our software meets that reality, and you'll own the clinical half of it — sitting between the nurses and medical directors who do the work today and the AI engineers building what replaces the parts of it that shouldn't exist. * **Own the clinical design of your deployment, end to end.** From workflow discovery, through configuration, testing, and go-live. You define what "clinically correct" means for the engagement, then hold the line on it.

* **Map workflows nobody has written down.** Health plans rarely have an accurate picture of their own review process. You'll sit with their nurses, build the process diagram that reflects what actually happens, and use it to show where Florence plugs in.

* **You're a clinician.** RN, BSN, NP, PA, or MD. You understand clinical terminology, patient-provider interaction, and what it feels like to be the person on the other side of a coverage decision.

Utilization management is the sweet spot, but adjacent depth — risk adjustment, HEDIS, care management, appeals — counts.
* **You're structured.** Intuitive workflow maps, clean processes, and clear written communication come naturally to you. You've probably built the training material or the SOP that a team then ran on.
* **You love being in front of customers.** Not tolerate it — enjoy it. You build relationships with clinical counterparts that outlast the project.
* **You have a real interest in AI.** You've gone looking for how these systems work rather than waiting to be told, and you have views on where they should and shouldn't be trusted with clinical judgment.

**At AQA, we’re committed to advancing education and we’re committed to our people. As the largest provider of academic qualifications in the UK, we mark over 10 million exam papers each year and it’s our people who make this happen.**

**Senior Strategy Manager, Education & Assessment Reform**

**Permanent | Full Time**  
**Manchester: £64,600 - £74,100**  
**Guildford / London: £67,200 - £77,200**

**Hybrid Working**

**Help shape the future of qualifications**

The education landscape is changing.

 

Curriculum reform, evolving customer expectations, advances in assessment technology and a rapidly changing policy environment are creating significant opportunities and challenges for awarding organisations.

 

This is your opportunity to help shape the response.

 

As Senior Strategy Manager, you'll play a key role in defining how AQA's qualifications evolve in response to reform. Working at the heart of our Product Management function, you'll help translate complex educational, market and policy developments into practical strategies that support schools, colleges, teachers and learners across the UK.

 

This is a rare opportunity to influence decisions at a national scale whilst working alongside senior leaders across the organisation to shape the future direction of qualifications.

 

**What you'll be doing**

You'll contribute to the development and delivery of AQA's assessment reform strategy, helping to ensure our products continue to meet the needs of customers, learners and the wider education sector. Your work will include:

* Shaping strategic thinking on complex education and qualification reform issues
* Supporting the development of long-term qualification and product strategies
* Using insight, evidence and research to inform recommendations and decision making
* Developing approaches to product prioritisation, planning and performance measurement
* Bringing together stakeholders from across the organisation to build alignment and momentum
* Translating strategic direction into practical actions and deliverable plans
* Identifying opportunities to innovate and respond to developments across education and assessment

 

You'll regularly work with senior stakeholders, influencing decisions, navigating ambiguity and helping the organisation make evidence-based choices in a fast-changing environment.

 

**You'll thrive in this role if you have:**

* Experience shaping strategy, products, programmes or large-scale change.
* The ability to turn complex information into clear, practical recommendations.
* Confidence working through ambiguity and using evidence and insight to inform decisions.
* Demonstrable stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and build alignment.
* Excellent analytical thinking, collaboration and sound judgement.
* An in-depth understanding of the education system in England.
* Experience gained within education, educational publishing, assessment, curriculum, product management, policy, strategy, transformation or a similarly complex environment.

 

**Why join us?**

Few organisations have the opportunity to influence education at the scale that AQA does.

This role offers the chance to contribute to one of the most significant periods of change the qualifications sector has experienced in decades. You'll help shape decisions that impact learners, teachers and education providers across the country while working alongside colleagues who are passionate about improving education.

You'll influence long-term strategy, work across a broad range of stakeholders and play a meaningful role in helping AQA navigate a complex and evolving landscape.

 

**What's in it for you?**

* A unique opportunity to influence qualification and assessment reform at a national level.
* Exposure to senior leaders and strategic decision-making across AQA.
* The chance to shape long-term product and qualification strategy.
* A varied role combining strategy, insight, stakeholder engagement and implementation.
* A 35-hour working week with flexible, hybrid working.
* 25 days' annual leave, rising to 30 days, plus Christmas closure days.
* A benefits package including a pension with combined contributions of up to 18.5%, healthcare support, wellbeing programmes and volunteering opportunities.
* The opportunity to be part of AQA's inclusive and values-led culture, with access to a range of employee networks and communities.

 

**What's next?**

To apply, please upload your CV together with a short supporting statement outlining:

* Why you're interested in this opportunity.
* The experience and skills you would bring to the role.
* How your background would help you contribute to AQA's assessment reform strategy

Further details, including interview preparation materials, will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and lived experiences.

**#ThinkFuture #ShapeEducation #StrategyJobs #EducationCareers #ProductStrategy #AssessmentReform #AREF**

**Summary**

Purpose:  
The Senior Manager – Reform Strategy is responsible for contributing to the development of AQA’s GQ reform strategy. Working closely with the Head of Reform Strategy and leaders across the organisation, they’ll be an important part of the team responsible for developing AQA’s overarching GQ reform strategy. Contributing to providing a clear and coherent vision and strategic intent, they’ll develop positions on cross-cutting strategic issues and support the development of effective subject strategies.  
  
They will act as a central authority on our products and assessment reform best practice, fostering organisational knowledge and capability through collaboration with internal stakeholders. Taking the lead on key elements of the strategic framework from inception to implementation, they’ll influence organisational decisions and ensure co-ordination with other strategic priorities and programmes.  
  
This role will report to the Head of Reform Strategy and will work closely with senior managers and Heads of Product across Product Management and with the Qualifications Development team as well as leaders and teams across the wider business. They’ll need to clearly communicate with authority our reform strategy across the business and understand its impact on the priorities of different business areas, including but not limited to Assessment, Operational delivery, Finance, Assessment Technology and Commercial teams.

# Flight Simulator Operator (LR05)

## **About Aquila ATMS**

At Aquila Air Traffic Management Services (ATMS), we are dedicated to creating a workplace where innovation, collaboration, and excellence thrives. As a joint venture between NATS and Thales, we combine the expertise of leading air traffic control services and global systems integration to deliver cutting-edge solutions in air traffic management.

Join us in shaping the future of air traffic management, and together, we will elevate aviation safety and efficiency worldwide!

---

## **The Role**

We are looking for a **Flight Simulator Operator** to join our team at **RAF Shawbury**.

This role supports the delivery of realistic military Air Traffic Control simulation exercises using Aquila's Air Traffic Control simulators. Based at the Defence College of Air and Space Operations, you will contribute to the training and development of military Air Traffic Controllers for the Royal Air Force, Royal Navy, and Foreign and Commonwealth personnel. The role is critical to delivering realistic, challenging and dynamic simulation exercises that help prepare Trainees for operational Air Traffic Control duties.

As a Flight Simulator Operator, you will create and manage realistic Air Traffic Management scenarios, support training delivery, and work closely with Trainers, Trainees and fellow Flight Simulator Operators to deliver high-quality simulation exercises.

This is a hands-on role where you will work within a professional training environment, respond to developing scenarios, and contribute to the successful delivery of military Air Traffic Control training programmes.

## **Core Responsibilities**

**Safety, Compliance and Risk Management**

· Operate the Aircraft Control Positions (ACPs) in accordance with approved procedures, training requirements and operational instructions to support the safe and effective delivery of training exercises.

· Maintain a high level of accuracy and attention to detail when managing simulator activity, ensuring simulation outputs remain aligned to exercise objectives and training standards.

· Comply with all applicable safety, security, quality and compliance requirements, promptly reporting hazards, incidents, procedural concerns or simulator anomalies through the appropriate channels.

**Delivery, Quality and Customer Focus**

· Deliver realistic, accurate and effective Air Traffic Control simulation activity that supports trainee development and the achievement of training objectives.

· Operate allocated simulator positions professionally and in accordance with exercise requirements, adapting simulator activity as necessary to support changing training scenarios and learning outcomes.

**Collaboration, Culture and Values in Action**

· Work collaboratively with Flight Simulator Operators, Exercise Supervisors and DCASO Trainers to support the effective delivery of simulation exercises and training objectives.

· Build and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders, demonstrating professionalism, respect, integrity and Aquila's Core Values in all interactions.

· Contribute to a positive learning environment by actively engaging with feedback, sharing knowledge and supporting the development of team capability.

· Support wider team and business activities by performing other duties as assigned, consistent with the responsibilities of the position and the needs of the Company.

**Innovation, Improvement and Future Capability**

· Maintain and develop competence across simulator disciplines, applying learning and best practice to support continual improvement in simulation delivery.

· Identify and raise opportunities to improve processes, training delivery or simulator effectiveness, contributing ideas that enhance operational performance and trainee experience.

· Support the ongoing development of simulator capability through constructive feedback and participation in improvement activities as required.

**Leadership, Direction and Stakeholder Engagement**

· Represent Aquila professionally when engaging with trainees, trainers and other stakeholders, helping to maintain confidence in the quality and effectiveness of the training environment.

---

## **About You**

You are someone who enjoys working in a structured yet dynamic environment and can maintain focus while responding to changing situations. You work effectively both independently and as part of a team, communicate information clearly, and take a practical approach to problem-solving.

You do not need previous Air Traffic Control experience to be successful in this role. We are interested in people who can learn new skills, use technology effectively, process information accurately and contribute positively to a collaborative team environment.

**Who You'll Work With**

The OpenConfig team who are responsible for building a dynamic, **programmable data centre infrastructure** using **software-defined networking** principles such as declarative configuration and model-driven management and operations.

**What You'll Do**

Arista’s engineering team started from a blank sheet of paper to architect an entirely new networking operating system. Arista’s unique architecture is based on three guiding principles:

1. State orientation

2. Open standards-based approach

3. Single software image consistency

1) State Orientation for publish-subscribe communication

State Orientation uses a unique multi-process state-sharing architecture that separates state information from protocol processing and application logic with a central database shared by diverse applications. Both system state and data are stored in the system database where data is accessed via an automated publish/subscribe model. This distinct design principle provides module independence, self-healing resiliency, and multi-process software stability. It is an elegant distributed systems solution applied holistically right across the network.  This contrasts with the decades-old legacy approach of many competitors that uses extensive inter-process communications (IPC), a shared memory bus, or a complex message passing framework to communicate across the system components.

2) An Open Approach

Arista took to heart the lessons of the open-source world and built EOS on top of an unmodified Linux kernel, maintaining full, secured access to the Linux shell and utilities. It is notable that it is the same Linux OS that Arista’s customers run in their data centers and on their servers. This foundational methodology enables EOS to preserve the security, feature development, and tools of the Linux community, unlike legacy approaches where the original **OS kernel** is either modified or based on older, less maintained versions. By adhering to open source **Linux**, EOS also natively supports Linux containers and virtual machines, simplifying the deployment of new services and enhancing DevOps practices.

3) A Single Image

Arista’s third and crucial guiding principle is to provide a single software image that runs across all products in various packaging forms - physical platforms, virtual machines, and containers.  The EOS single image uses the same source code, and the same version of the software released across the entire portfolio of switches and routers, thus improving network testing and reliability while reducing the complexity and cost of network operations.  This approach is a large differentiator to legacy vendors who use multiple operating systems with numerous images to implement a siloed network. Managing these multiple software images with quality control testing or new features testing multiplies operational costs. In contrast, when Arista releases a new software version, customers merely deploy a single image network-wide. In addition, having a single image improves automation workflows by allowing DevOps tools, such as Ansible or Terraform, to work across all Arista devices with a single integration. Using these integrations, operators can establish Continuous Integration (CI) pipelines that build, test, and deploy network configurations across the entire data center with increased speed and reliability.

## Company Description

We're ASOS, the online retailer for fashion lovers all around the world.

We exist to give our customers the confidence to be whoever they want to be, and that goes for our people too. At ASOS, you're free to be your true self without judgement, and channel your creativity into a platform used by millions.

Everyone needs some help showing up as their best self. We're Disability Confident Committed - let our Talent team know if you need any reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process

## Job Description

ASOS is embarking on an exciting digital transformation, evolving our Product team with a powerful new way of working that places our digital products at the heart of our business. We are seeking a talented Senior Product Designer to play a pivotal role in ensuring its success.

We currently receive over 2.5 billion visits per year, have more than 23 million active customers, and over 50 million unique visitors per month. This creates a highly committed and exciting environment with opportunities to develop best-in-class digital products.

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll be an integral part of one of our many product development areas. We operate in a fast-paced, rapidly changing product org, partnering with cross-functional teams to solve real customer problems through experimentation and data-driven decision-making, leveraging AI to shape how customers experience and shop for fashion online.

We're building an immersive, personalised, outfit-based shopping experience, one that makes discovery feel less like searching a traditional product grid and more like you’re working with a personal stylist. We’re designing our app to be one of the most exciting destinations to discover your next look, while shaping our digital product org to be a place where craft, speed, and new ways of working enable us to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Join us and be part of ASOS’s digital revolution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own end-to-end design of native mobile experiences from discovery through to shipped, measured, and iterated product.
* Design and champion reusable patterns and components that scale across the mobile product, knowing when to use the design system and when to push it forward.
* Prototype early and often, in Figma, code, or AI-assisted tools, to make ideas tangible for your team and stakeholders faster than a deck ever could.
* Bring native platform craft: deep fluency in iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design, with pixel-perfect execution and an eye for motion and interaction detail.
* Collaborate closely with a cross-functional team including product managers, engineers, business partners and stakeholders, driving end-to-end delivery and being accountable for the performance and success of your initiatives.
* Conduct and apply quantitative and qualitative research to validate design choices and keep decisions customer-led.
* Use AI tools as part of your own practice, for exploration, prototyping, and production, and help the wider team build that fluency.
* Champion the user and improve ASOS's accessibility standards in everything you ship.
* Understand the technology, data, and business logic underpinning the experiences you design, and design with those constraints, not around them.
* Communicate design decisions, trade-offs, and research findings clearly and early, and use that clarity to influence stakeholders.
* Stay close to what's next, new AI capabilities, native platform updates, and emerging interaction patterns, and bring that thinking into the work.

## Qualifications

**About You:**

* You have significant experience designing native mobile products, with deep fluency in iOS and/or Android platform conventions and a portfolio that shows real craft, not just wireframes.
* You're a systems thinker — comfortable designing a single flow and the scalable pattern behind it, so the whole team moves faster because of your work.
* You prototype to think and to sell ideas and you'd rather show something working than pitch a static deck.
* You're AI-native in how you work: you use AI tools day-to-day in your own design process, and you're excited to design entirely new patterns for AI-driven experiences.
* You have a strong track record in user research and experimentation, translating quantitative and qualitative insights into confident design decisions.
* You're an expert in Figma and modern prototyping tools, fluent in building and evolving design system patterns.
* You communicate with clarity and confidence, able to articulate design rationale and influence senior stakeholders.
* You're adaptive, thrive in ambiguity, and bring a growth mindset to a fast-moving, product-led environment.
* You care, visibly, about the customer and about shipping work that's both beautiful and effective.

* Discretionary bonus scheme

* Opportunity for personalised learning and in-the-moment experiences that enable you to thrive and excel in your role

## Job Description

ASOS is embarking on an exciting digital transformation, evolving our Product team with a powerful new way of working that places our digital products at the heart of our business. We are seeking a talented Senior Product Designer to play a pivotal role in ensuring its success.

We currently receive over 2.5 billion visits per year, have more than 23 million active customers, and over 50 million unique visitors per month. This creates a highly committed and exciting environment with opportunities to develop best-in-class digital products.

As a Senior Product Designer working on our Android app, you’ll work across many of our product development areas. Our Android customers span a huge range of devices, screen sizes and markets, and designing well for them means designing for that reality. We operate in a fast-paced, rapidly changing product org, partnering with cross-functional teams to solve real customer problems through experimentation and data-driven decision-making, leveraging AI to shape how customers experience and shop for fashion online.

We're building an immersive, personalised, outfit-based shopping experience — one that makes discovery feel less like searching a traditional product grid and more like you're working with a personal stylist. We're designing our app to be one of the most exciting destinations to discover your next look, while shaping our digital product org to be a place where craft, speed, and new ways of working enable us to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Join us and be part of ASOS's digital revolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end design of native Android experiences from discovery through to shipped, measured, and iterated product.
* Bring deep Android platform craft: fluency in Material 3, dynamic colour and theming, gesture and predictive back navigation, edge-to-edge layouts, dark theme, notifications, widgets, and the Play Store surfaces that shape first impressions.
* Design for the breadth of the Android ecosystem — multiple densities and screen sizes, adaptive layouts for tablets, large screens and foldables, and strong performance and perceived speed on mid- and lower-tier devices in every market we trade in.
* Design and champion reusable patterns and components that scale across the Android app, knowing when to use the design system and when to push it forward. Partner with our iOS design counterpart to keep the ASOS experience coherent across platforms while respecting each platform's idioms — parity where it matters to customers, platform-native where it matters to quality.
* Work closely with Android engineers in the language of the platform, translating design into Jetpack Compose-friendly structures, components and tokens so intent survives implementation.
* Prototype early and often, in Figma, code, or AI-assisted tools, to make ideas tangible for your team and stakeholders faster than a deck ever could — including on-device, so motion and gesture are judged in the hand rather than on a screen share.
* Collaborate closely with a cross-functional team including product managers, engineers, business partners and stakeholders, driving end-to-end delivery and being accountable for the performance and success of your initiatives.
* Conduct and apply quantitative and qualitative research to validate design choices and keep decisions customer-led.
* Use AI tools as part of your own practice, for exploration, prototyping, and production, and help the wider team build that fluency.
* Champion the user and improve ASOS's accessibility standards in everything you ship, including TalkBack behaviour, focus order, touch target sizing and support for large font and display scaling.
* Understand the technology, data, and business logic underpinning the experiences you design, and design with those constraints, not around them.
* Communicate design decisions, trade-offs, and research findings clearly and early, and use that clarity to influence stakeholders.
* Stay close to what's next — new AI capabilities, each Android release and Material update, and emerging interaction patterns — and bring that thinking into the work.

## Qualifications

* You have significant experience designing and shipping native Android products, with a portfolio that shows real craft on the platform.
* You know Material 3 well enough to know when to follow it, when to extend it, and when a strong brand expression should take precedence.
* You're comfortable designing for fragmentation: adaptive layouts and large screens, varied hardware performance, and the accessibility settings real customers actually have switched on.
* You work fluently with Android engineers, understand how Kotlin and Compose shape what's cheap and expensive to build, and use that knowledge to make better design decisions earlier.
* You're a systems thinker — comfortable designing a single flow and the scalable pattern behind it, so the whole team moves faster because of your work.
* You prototype to think and to sell ideas, and you'd rather show something working on a device than pitch a static deck.
* You're AI-native in how you work: you use AI tools day-to-day in your own design process, and you're excited to design entirely new patterns for AI-driven experiences.
* You have a strong track record in user research and experimentation, translating quantitative and qualitative insights into confident design decisions.
* You're an expert in Figma and modern prototyping tools, fluent in building and evolving design system patterns across platforms.
* You communicate with clarity and confidence, able to articulate design rationale and influence senior stakeholders.
* You're adaptive, thrive in ambiguity, and bring a growth mindset to a fast-moving, product-led environment.
* You care, visibly, about the customer and about shipping work that's both beautiful and effective.

Remote, United Kingdom | Remote

### What You'll Do

Role Summary (Why This Role Exists Now)

Global e-invoicing and Continuous Transaction Control (CTC) regulations are evolving rapidly, requiring organizations to adapt business processes and technology at an unprecedented pace. As Avalara expands its E-Invoicing and Live Reporting (ELR) capabilities, we need experienced functional consultants who can translate complex regulatory requirements into scalable implementation designs that accelerate customer adoption and ensure compliance.

The Senior Functional Consultant serves as the critical bridge between regulatory mandates, business processes, and technical implementation teams. Working across Product, Engineering, Professional Services, ERP Connector teams, and strategic partners, this role transforms evolving global requirements into repeatable implementation patterns that improve delivery consistency, reduce deployment friction, and help customers achieve faster time-to-value.

How This Role Elevates Avalara

This role will:

* Accelerate customer adoption of Avalara’s ELR platform through consistent, high-quality solution design.

* Improve implementation quality by translating evolving global mandates into standardized, reusable implementation patterns.

* Reduce deployment friction and implementation risk across customers, partners, and ERP ecosystems.

* Increase scalability by reducing dependency on individual subject matter experts through documentation, frameworks, and repeatable assets.

* Strengthen collaboration across Product, Engineering, Professional Services, and strategic partners to improve customer outcomes.

* Support Avalara’s AI-first strategy by incorporating AI into functional analysis, documentation, and implementation processes where appropriate.

### What Your Responsibilities Will Be

The successful candidate will:

* Partner with regulatory SMEs to understand new and evolving global e-invoicing and CTC requirements.

* Translate complex regulatory mandates into structured business requirements, functional designs, implementation guidance, and reusable solution patterns.

* Analyze customer Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C) business processes and map them to Avalara’s ELR platform capabilities.

* Guide implementation teams, integration teams, and partners through mandate-specific solution design and implementation decisions.

* Support customer onboarding, solution design workshops, and implementation activities to improve deployment quality and customer outcomes.

* Identify implementation risks, dependencies, and gaps while driving cross-functional resolution.

* Serve as the primary functional liaison between regulatory experts, Product Management, Engineering, ERP Connector teams, Professional Services, and external partners.

* Develop implementation documentation, training materials, and partner enablement resources that improve consistency and scalability.

* Monitor global regulatory changes and assess their impact on existing solution designs and implementation approaches.

* Continuously improve methodologies, frameworks, reusable assets, and implementation standards across the ELR ecosystem.

12-Month Success Signals

Within the first 12 months, this consultant will:

* Deliver functional designs that improve implementation consistency across multiple global mandates.

* Reduce onboarding and implementation friction through reusable documentation, standardized patterns, and improved solution guidance.

* Increase connector and partner readiness for new regulatory requirements.

* Improve customer deployment success rates and accelerate time-to-value.

* Reduce dependency on regulatory SMEs by developing scalable implementation assets.

* Strengthen cross-functional collaboration across Product, Engineering, Professional Services, and partner organizations.

* Contribute AI-enabled approaches that improve documentation quality, analysis, or implementation efficiency.

### What You’ll Need To Be Successful

AI Bar Raiser Expectations

At Avalara, all consultants are expected to apply AI in ways that improve customer outcomes, delivery quality, and operational effectiveness. As an AI Bar Raiser, this role will help advance how functional consulting leverages AI to accelerate analysis, improve implementation quality, and scale knowledge across the organization.

The successful candidate will:

* Use approved AI tools to accelerate requirements analysis, documentation development, solution design, and knowledge management.

* Identify opportunities where AI can improve implementation efficiency, customer readiness, or internal productivity.

* Apply AI responsibly while validating outputs against regulatory requirements and business needs.

* Demonstrate measurable improvements in implementation quality, delivery speed, or documentation effectiveness through AI-enabled approaches.

* Share AI best practices and reusable approaches that improve team capability.

Bar Raiser Expectations

At Avalara, we hire Bar Raisers, professionals who elevate how teams solve problems, collaborate, and deliver customer value. As a Senior Functional Consultant, this role is expected to strengthen implementation quality, improve cross-functional execution, and leave customers, partners, and internal teams better equipped for future success.

The successful candidate will:

* Demonstrate strong ownership and accountability for customer implementation outcomes.

* Raise standards for solution quality, functional documentation, and implementation consistency.

* Build trusted relationships across Product, Engineering, Professional Services, partners, and customers.

* Mentor peers by sharing expertise, reusable assets, and implementation best practices.

* Exercise sound judgment when balancing customer needs, regulatory requirements, and scalable solution design.

* Leave implementation frameworks, documentation, and cross-functional processes stronger than they found them.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline and 7+ years of experience in ERP consulting, solution architecture, business analysis, product ownership, or enterprise software implementation.

* Strong understanding of Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C) business processes.

* Experience with invoice lifecycle management, accounts payable, accounts receivable, procurement, and financial operations.

* Ability to translate business requirements into technical designs and implementation guidance.

* Experience with ERP platforms including SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365, NetSuite, Workday, Infor, or similar enterprise systems.

* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and facilitation skills.

* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting global e-invoicing, indirect tax compliance, CTC frameworks, PEPPOL, or digital reporting mandates.

* Product ownership or product management experience.

* Experience designing enterprise integrations, APIs, or solution architectures.

* Familiarity with SaaS implementation methodologies and partner ecosystems.

* Experience working with system integrators, ISVs, or strategic technology partners.

* Knowledge of B2B transaction processing and electronic document exchange.

### Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products.  Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

### How We’ll Take Care Of You

Total Rewards 

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses. 

Health & Wellness   
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance. 

Inclusive culture and diversity   
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

## Job description

We are growing our scientific team at ExpressionEdits and are offering an opportunity to join us in a full-time role as a Senior/Principal Scientist, Protein Sciences based at our laboratories in the Babraham Research Campus near Cambridge.

About ExpressionEdits:

At ExpressionEdits, we are revolutionizing biotechnology to create therapeutics that nobody else can. We have gone back to the basic building block of the field, the transgene, which has remained essentially stagnant since the 1970s, and re-invented its design based on our proprietary method of intronization.

With this technology, we can turn the artificial transgenes of the past into sequences that incorporate both coding and non-coding DNA to express more effectively, while also looking more like a cell’s natural genes. We believe this approach, guided by our artificial intelligence “Engine” for genetic design, will allow us to bring forth the full potential of genetic production.

We are a growing startup company within Cambridge’s synthetic biology community which you can join as an early member of our diverse team that spans biology, engineering, data science, and operations. With your help, we can bring our vision of ‘building biology like nature’ to life.

Position overview:

This is a senior, hands-on laboratory role responsible for the expression, purification and analytical characterisation of recombinant proteins - including antibodies and other therapeutic biologics - to support preclinical drug discovery. The Senior/Principal Scientist will bring deep technical expertise in mammalian (CHO/HEK) expression and protein engineering, working across teams to exemplify and advance the company's intron technology platform. The role holder will independently lead purification work, generate high-quality analytical data to support programme decisions, and act as a technical reference point for less experienced scientists in the team.

Responsibilities

· Recombinant Protein Expression:

Design, execute and optimise recombinant protein expression in mammalian systems (CHO and HEK), including transient and stable formats, for antibodies and other therapeutic proteins.

Apply protein engineering principles, assessing structure-function relationships, to inform construct design and troubleshoot poorly expressing or unstable molecules; exposure to computational modelling to support this work would be an advantage.

· Purification, Analytics and Quality:

Independently plan and execute protein purification workflows from milligram to gram scale, using the AKTA chromatography platform (including the AKTA avant) across multiple modes of chromatography (e.g. Protein A/affinity, ion exchange, size exclusion).

Maintain working knowledge of scale-up and technology transfer to CDMOs, and of the stages toward IND filing for a biologic, so that preclinical work anticipates downstream manufacturability needs.

Design and perform analytical characterisation (e.g. HPLC-based methods such as SEC, RP, IEX) to support preclinical QC release and characterisation packages, such as stability studies.

Maintain rigorous documentation in line with good scientific and record-keeping practice, ensuring data is fit for use in regulatory and IP contexts.

· Technical Leadership and Collaboration

Act as a technical expert and point of reference for protein expression, purification and analytics, supporting and mentoring more junior scientists.

Qualifications, experience and skills:

Qualifications and Experience:

Essential:

PhD in a relevant discipline (e.g. biochemistry, molecular biology, protein science) would be ideal; equivalent industry experience will also be considered.

Hands-on experience of recombinant protein expression in CHO and/or HEK systems, including transfection (e.g. transient transfection for HEK, stable pool/cell line generation for CHO), and of protein engineering with a good understanding of structure-function relationships.

Experience working on antibodies or other therapeutic recombinant proteins within a biotech (or equivalent industry) environment.

Direct experience of protein purification to gram scale, including hands-on use of the AKTA chromatography platform, ideally the AKTA avant.

Experience with HPLC and other protein analytical techniques used for QC purposes.

Comfortable in a role that is predominantly laboratory-based.

Desirable:

Experience of technology transfer to CDMOs, and understanding of the stages toward IND filing for a biologic.

Knowledge or experience of SEC-MALS, mass spectrometry, DLS, CE-SDS, Biacore/SPR (binding kinetics), or cell-based potency assays, particularly mass spectrometry.

Exposure to computational modelling to support protein engineering.

Experience designing and running protein stability studies (e.g. thermal, freeze-thaw, forced degradation) to support candidate selection and characterisation packages.

Knowledge or experience of cell line development, and broader awareness of biologics drug discovery.

Desire to continuous learning and professional growth; eager to develop new skills in alignment with the company’s scientific advancements.

# Senior Customer Engineer - Pre & Post Sales

London, UK

## The Team + The Role

Pendo’s Customer Engineering team is the technical backbone of the pre- and post-sales customer motion. The team brings together work that has historically sat across Customer Success, Technical Account Management, and Solutions Engineering into one full-lifecycle technical owner. Customer Engineering helps customers connect technical execution to business outcomes and realize the value of their investment in Pendo.

## The Team + The Role

Pendo’s **Customer Engineering team** is the technical backbone of the ***pre- and post-sales customer motion.***

The team brings together work across Customer Success, Technical Account Management, and Solutions Engineering into one full-lifecycle technical owner. Customer Engineering helps customers connect technical execution to business outcomes and realize the value of their investment in Pendo.

As a ***Senior Customer Engineer*** you will own strategic and complex Enterprise accounts across acquisition, implementation, adoption, expansion, and escalation. You will lead technical strategy for complex deployments, resolve ambiguous customer challenges, and partner closely with account teams to drive retention, expansion, and customer value. Your impact will extend beyond your own accounts through playbooks, coaching, repeatable fixes, and workflow improvements that raise the capability of the broader Customer Engineering team.

This role is based in our **London office.**

## What this looks like day-to-day

* **New customer acquisition and selling:** Partner with Account Directors on **pre-sales**motions for ***new customer acquisition, product expansion, and growth across lines of business.*** You identify customer pain, craft and deliver tailored demos, and lead technical evaluations through requirements gathering, success criteria, installation guidance, and hands-on workshops.
* **Quarterly business outcomes:** Drive measurable improvement in customer health, retention, expansion, and technical resolution across strategic accounts. You contribute at least one reusable framework, playbook, or process that other Customer Engineers use and become a trusted advisor to Account Directors on account health and technical strategy.
* **Adoption, expansion, and growth:** Identify opportunities to ***expand adoption***across underutilized features, untapped products, and new lines of business. When adoption stalls, you diagnose root causes, design a path forward, and connect technical work to measurable business outcomes.
* **Complex implementations and value realization:** Lead onboarding for strategic customers, including planning, implementation, integrations, and training. You build customer-specific implementation playbooks, guide complex deployments with executive visibility, and ensure customers realize value during onboarding and over time.
* **Team capability building:** Build playbooks, document repeatable fixes, coach peers, and improve how Customer Engineering work gets done across the team. You use AI tools to accelerate content creation, surface patterns across accounts, and share practical workflow findings with the broader team.
* **Early account impact:** Assess account health, risks, stakeholder relationships, and the highest-priority problems to solve within your portfolio. You establish trust with Account Directors and customer stakeholders, then independently lead complex customer interactions that move accounts forward.
* **Technical escalation:** Serve as an escalation point for complex technical challenges raised by other Customer Engineers. You resolve ambiguous problems with multiple variables and tradeoffs, involving Product or Engineering only when truly needed.

## Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

***You're a builder, not a maintainer.***You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Senior Customer Engineers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

***You're AI-curious - genuinely.***You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.

## Must-haves

* Passion for working with customers and building strong and impactful customer relationships
* 5 to 8 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Management, Customer Engineering, implementation, professional services, or solutions architecture.
* Deep hands-on experience with web technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and REST APIs, with the ability to architect and troubleshoot complex front-end implementations.
* Proven experience managing strategic Enterprise accounts with executive-level stakeholders, competing priorities, and complex technical or business requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous problems involving multiple variables, constraints, and tradeoffs.
* Experience connecting technical execution to business outcomes such as retention, expansion, ROI, and value realization.
* Hands-on use of AI tools for account research, content creation, or workflow automation, with demonstrated integration into day-to-day work rather than light experimentation.
* Experience mentoring or coaching more junior technical team members.

## Nice-to-haves

* Experience with Pendo, digital adoption platforms, product analytics, or in-app experience tooling in an enterprise environment.
* Hands-on experience with mobile app development, including Swift, Android, or React Native.
* Familiarity with data architecture, AI or machine learning concepts, or advanced analytics instrumentation.
* Track record of building reusable frameworks, playbooks, or processes that were adopted by a broader team.

## About Pendo

Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success.
