# Data Analyst, Operations

United Kingdom

Brainlabs is the independent, founder-led agency building the future of media. We have over 1000 Brainlabbers based across the global, all united through the 12 principles laid out in our Culture Code. We're full-service, with people and AI agents working side by side, all aligned to one thing: maximizing our clients' revenue through a genuinely scientific approach to media. If you want to help play your part in achieving this for the world's biggest brands in an environment that will support and challenge you in equal measure, this is where you do it.

**What's the role**

We're looking for a Data Analyst to own the flow of data between our operational systems, our data warehouse and the rest of the business. Systems like Hubspot and our People Planner, hold the client, revenue and pipeline data that Finance, Ops and Client Leadership rely on. This role keeps that data well structured, reliably synced and trustworthy as it moves into BigQuery and back out into the tools people use every day. A key part of the job is getting the right, live data presented cleanly in Notion, so client teams can actually use it to inform their day to day workflows.

**What you do**

* Build and maintain integrations that move operating system data into the data warehouse.
* Push data warehouse data back into operating systems to create complete workflows and data lifecycles
* Debug data discrepancies across source systems and downstream tools, identifying the causes and automating solutions to prevent issues moving forward.
* Own HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) as a system of record: properties, associations, lifecycle stages etc. and the automation that keeps them consistent, including data quality, deduplication and governance at scale.
* Work closely with finance, operations, and other business support teams, translating technical decisions into terms non-technical stakeholders can act on.

**Who you are**

* Deep experience managing data structure (objects, properties, associations, lifecycle stages, automation), not just using it as an end user, with strong data quality and governance practices (deduplication, enrichment, validation, access controls, auditability).
* Able to turn a non-technical brief into a full plan and build it, and explain technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders without jargon.
* Comfortable in fast-moving rollouts, balancing speed with long-term architecture as requirements evolve.
* Experience building sync logic (canonical IDs, upserts, change detection, idempotent reruns) and ETL/ELT pipelines that survive repeated runs without duplicating or corrupting data.
* Experience integrating data into BigQuery, Snowflake or similar warehouses via API-based integrations, including reverse ETL back into business systems.
* Strong Python (or similar) and SQL for automation, data movement, transformation and validation across warehouse tables and views.
* Confident with REST APIs (auth, pagination, rate limits, retries, error handling) and GCP tooling (Cloud Run, Cloud Scheduler, Secret Manager, BigQuery, GitHub Actions) for building and orchestrating automated jobs.
* Able to debug data discrepancies across source systems and downstream tools, with good version control hygiene (GitHub or similar).

**How you succeed**

* Data moves between systems reliably and accurately at scale
* Systems stay clean at scale, with properties and associations that hold up as volume grows.
* Data discrepancies get caught and fixed at the source
* Finance, operations and other business teams trust the numbers
* New integrations and automations are shipped with documentation and clear guidance
* You balance shipping quickly against building for the long term, and can explain that trade-off to a non-technical stakeholder in plain terms.

**What happens next?**

We know searching for a job is tough and that you want to find the best career and employer for you. We also want to ensure that this position is the best fit for both you and us. Therefore, you will participate in a comprehensive interview process that includes skills interviews with our team. The goal of this process is to allow you to get to know us as we learn more about you.

**A note on our offices:** We pride ourselves in being a company with an office-centric culture and, for the majority of roles we expect people to be in commuting distance of the office and come in for around 3 days per week.

### Project Manager, Strategic and Co-Chair Communications

Communications - London (Hybrid)

---

Position title: Project Manager, Strategic and Co-Chair Communications

Department: Communications

Reporting to: Director, Strategic Communications, Media and Partnerships

Location: London - Please note that if your right to work in one of the listed locations is not confirmed at the time of applying, C40 will be unable to proceed with your application. 

Salary:  (Grade 4) GBP £54,920 gross per annum - Due to its commitment to maintain equity and fairness, C40 operates on a spot salary model. This means that our employees are paid the same salary according to their grade and location. 

Term: Indefinite contract

Background 

C40 is a network of nearly 100 mayors of the world’s leading cities, who are working to deliver the urgent action needed right now to confront the climate crisis, and create a future where everyone, everywhere can thrive. Mayors of C40 cities are committed to using a science-based and people-focused approach to help the world limit global heating to 1.5°C and build healthy, equitable and resilient communities. Through a Global Green New Deal, mayors are working alongside a broad coalition of representatives from labour, business, the youth climate movement and civil society to go further and faster than ever before.

Our international staff work with the C40 network under the leadership of city governments to deliver this mission. Using a data-driven approach, our team identifies and promotes the exchange of proven programmes and policies developed by cities; provides world-class research, technical expertise and access to key partners to deliver new programmes and policies with cities; and communicates cities’ individual achievements and collective leadership.

Diversity Statement

C40 is committed to supporting and promoting equity and diversity and creating an inclusive working environment for everyone. We believe that when people with different life experiences are involved in decision-making, we deliver better. 

We believe having a diverse workforce ensures we connect better with all the different communities and people affected by the climate crisis. This enables us to make better decisions which lead to better outcomes in the work we do through increased creativity, productivity, greater global impact alongside a broader perspective and approach to our work.

We welcome applicants that are diverse in terms of age, gender identity, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity and perspective. Our goal is for C40 to be an environment where everyone, from any background, can flourish and can be themselves whilst contributing to our mission. If you identify as a person with a disability, we work to provide reasonable appropriate measures and any additional support needed to provide an equitable working experience. If you are living with a disability, chronic illness or neurodiversity please inform us, to provide you with the proper assistance in the application process.

C40 promotes a work culture where staff can input to improve equity, diversity and inclusion through staff-led groups and formal forums. We know that creating our ideal working environment is a learning process and we are committed to the ongoing effort. 

Department Description:

The C40 Communications team is responsible for strategically positioning C40 as one of the world’s most impactful climate organisations by celebrating the ambitious, equitable action underway in C40 cities and establishing our mayors as global leaders of the climate movement. Through our global communications we aim to shift the narrative and inspire real progress on the greatest challenge humanity is facing today.

Position Description:

This role will be at the heart of C40’s communications team. The role will support the Director to undertake various exciting activities including co-leading on strategic communications, media and partnerships creating and executing communications activities, ensuring the delivery of key communications projects with other C40 teams and providing specific support to the Co-Chair’s communications.

The post holder will co-lead and undertake strategic communications activities and lead on special projects related to strategic communications work which advance climate change action all around the world.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Communications

* Support the delivery of strategic communications plans for key organisational priorities and milestones, including drafting first versions of communications plans under the direction of the Director of Strategic Communications, Media and Partnerships. Coordinate the implementation of communications plans, tracking deliverables, timelines, dependencies and progress to ensure timely and effective execution.
* Monitor the delivery and impact of communications activities, identifying opportunities to strengthen execution and improve outcomes.
* Support the delivery of strategic communications for the Breathe Cities programme, working under the guidance of the team Director.
* Support the Director in the coordination, management and growth of the Communications Network, helping to maintain strong relationships with members and ensure ongoing engagement.
* Support the planning and delivery of network convenings, including but not limited to project coordination, agenda development, coordinating presentations, logistics and speaker briefings.
* Coordinate follow-up activities after network convenings, including tracking actions, sharing resources and maintaining member engagement.
* Maintain network records, contact lists and engagement trackers, ensuring accurate information and effective relationship management.
* Support broader communications planning and cross-team coordination, helping ensure alignment across organisational priorities.
* Draft and edit communications content e.g. key messages, press releases, statements, emails.
* And any other duties appropriate for the grade.

**Specific Accountabilities**

* Conduct inspections, examinations and audits of aerodromes and Rescue and Fire Fighting Services (RFFS) within the UK Overseas Territories to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and the maintenance of high aviation safety standards.

* Apply Safety Management System (SMS) and Quality Management System (QMS) principles using a proportionate risk-based approach.

* Maintain compliance information relating to relevant ICAO Annexes and regulatory requirements.
* Work closely with Departments of Civil Aviation (DCAs) and OTAAs to support the effective implementation of aviation regulations and standards.
* Support the design and delivery of technical training and regulatory development programmes.
* Provide specialist advice and guidance to aviation regulators and stakeholders across the Overseas Territories.
* Represent ASSI and the Overseas Territories at national and international aviation forums.
* Undertake additional duties commensurate with the level and scope of the role.

**About You**

**Essential Criteria**

* Significant experience in aerodrome operations, aerodrome management, aviation safety oversight or airport operations.

This is not a traditional back-office finance role. You won’t be hiding inside a massive ERP system or waiting for a process manual. It’s a hands-on, high-impact seat for someone fast, curious, and comfortable navigating the dynamic environment of a scaling tech startup.  
  
You'll be responsible for monthly controlling, budgeting, forecasting, and delivering the crucial analytical insights that drive board-level decision-making. * Turn data into business insights: deliver high-impact ad-hoc analyses and business cases that give senior leadership a crystal-clear view of performance, risks, and strategic options.
* Deliver executive reporting: prepare internal management reporting for leadership and the board, while supporting external reporting for investors, lenders, and auditors.

* Partner across teams: act as a Finance Business Partner to leadership and key stakeholders across Switzerland, Germany, and the UK.

* International environment: collaborate daily with colleagues and leadership across Switzerland, Germany, the UK, and Europe in a genuinely global organization.

* An ambitious team that moves fast: collaborative, supportive, and focused on building something exceptional.

# Senior Manager - Global Procurement Data Foundation & Intelligence

**Senior Manager – Global Procurement Data Foundation & Intelligence**

**Location:** Carlsberg Headquarters, Copenhagen or Group Procurement UK Hub, Hemel Hempstead

Carlsberg Group is one of the world's leading brewing companies, with a strong portfolio of beer and beverage brands and operations across multiple markets.

Procurement is a strategic business function and trusted partner to the organisation, orchestrating value from a diverse global supplier ecosystem. Our purpose is to drive competitive total value from suppliers to enable profitable and sustainable business growth.

# **Role Overview**

We are looking for a Senior Manager – Global Procurement Data Foundation & Intelligence to lead the development of Global Procurement's data foundation, performance visibility and decision insights.

Reporting directly to the Head of Global Procurement Excellence, the role is accountable for establishing trusted procurement data, defining KPI architecture and reporting standards, owning the global procurement dashboard landscape, and ensuring insights are used to support fact-based decision-making across Procurement.

Working closely with Procurement, Finance, IIT teams, the successful candidate will build the foundations required to support Procurement's strategic digitalisation journey, enabling scalable analytics, automation and future-ready procurement capabilities. The role ensures data is trusted, insights are actionable, and performance visibility drives faster and better decisions across markets and categories.

# **What You’ll Be Doing**

**Build and strengthen procurement data foundations**

* Define procurement data standards, reporting logic and data governance principles.
* Establish a trusted single source of truth for procurement performance reporting.
* Improve data quality, consistency and transparency across systems and processes.
* Partner with Digital, IT and Finance to address data gaps and structural issues.
* Ensure data readiness for digitalisation, automation and future AI initiatives.

**Own procurement intelligence and reporting**

* Own the global procurement dashboard landscape and reporting framework.
* Define KPI architecture, performance views and reporting standards.
* Ensure dashboards and reports are accurate, timely and relevant to business needs.
* Continuously improve usability, consistency and adoption of reporting outputs.
* Support leadership reviews with fact-based analysis and clear performance messages.

**Generate actionable insights**

* Translate data into practical insights for procurement leaders, categories and markets.
* Identify performance trends, risks, gaps and value opportunities.
* Increase visibility of procurement performance and value delivery.
* Connect analytics outputs to business decisions, not only reporting activity.

**Lead analytics capability development**

* Provide leadership and direction to procurement analysts through a dotted-line model.
* Set common ways of working for analytics, dashboard development and performance measurement.
* Build analytical capability and reporting discipline across the procurement organisation.
* Promote consistent use of data, KPIs and insights in business routines.

**Enable digital and data evolution**

* Support procurement digital programmes through robust data foundations.
* Contribute to reporting automation and process efficiency initiatives.
* Collaborate with Digital and AI teams to enable scalable analytical capabilities.
* Ensure new tools and solutions are supported by clear data definitions and ownership.

# **What We’re Looking For**

**Data Foundation & Intelligence**

* Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, data ownership and reporting standards.
* Ability to design scalable KPI frameworks, reporting structures and performance measurement approaches.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with a structured approach to turning complex data into actionable insights.
* Understanding of enterprise data landscapes, including ERP, procurement, finance and reporting platforms.

**Analytics & Business Intelligence**

* Strong practical experience with Power BI, Tableau or comparable analytics and visualisation platforms.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable analytical and reporting solutions.
* Ability to communicate insights clearly and influence decisions through data.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Ability to build alignment across business, digital and technical teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills in matrix organisations.
* Ability to lead through expertise, establish standards and drive adoption without direct authority.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments while maintaining structure and consistency.

# **Growth Mindset**

We are looking for someone who:

* Takes ownership of outcomes and is accountable for your delivery
* Brings structure and consistency to complex environments by establishing clear standards, governance and ways of working.
* Leads through expertise and collaboration, building alignment across Procurement, Finance and IIT
* Balances strategic thinking with hands-on execution, turning roadmaps into measurable progress.
* Communicates complex data topics in a clear and practical way for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Maintains high standards while remaining pragmatic and effective in ambiguous and evolving environments.

# **Experience**

* Proven experience in analytics, business intelligence, data governance, performance management or related disciplines.
* Experience managing data across multiple enterprise systems, such as ERP, procurement, finance, analytics or reporting platforms.
* Experience establishing and governing KPI frameworks, data standards, dashboards and reporting solutions across multiple stakeholders and functions.
* Experience improving data quality, analytical capabilities and data-driven ways of working within complex organisational and technology environments.
* Experience leading analysts or analytics-focused transformation initiatives and influencing stakeholders in a matrix organisation.
* Procurement experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite.

# **Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Management Information Systems (MIS), Information Management, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Supply Chain or a related field.
* Advanced degree or relevant certifications in analytics, data governance, business intelligence, information management, data management, project management or procurement are an advantage.

# **Languages**

* Fluent English, spoken and written.
* Other languages are an advantage.

# **What You Can Expect**

* Ownership of Global Procurement's data foundation, intelligence capability and dashboard landscape.
* Opportunity to shape how procurement performance, value delivery and decision-making are enabled across the organisation.
* A key role in building the foundations for Procurement's digitalisation, automation and future-ready capabilities.
* Close collaboration with senior stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, Digital and IT, with strong visibility across the global organisation.
* A dynamic international environment with the opportunity to create sustainable and measurable impact.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.

## Description

Civica builds software that runs essential public services. Our systems support local government, the NHS, housing associations, and financial institutions: services that millions of people depend on every day. When our software works well, caseworkers make better decisions, clinicians access the right information, and councils deliver services that communities rely on.

We’re not a startup chasing the next hype cycle. We’re a company with deep roots in the public sector, working on problems that matter, and we’re investing seriously in how we build software to make sure we can keep doing that for the next decade.

**Why we feel you'll like the role of Senior Engineering Manager**

You’ll lead a domain of 6–10 teams (roughly 60–90 engineers), manage the Engineering Managers who run those teams day to day, and report to the Director of Engineering. It’s a manager-of-managers role, working alongside Product and commercial leadership as a peer, not just a bigger single team and not a purely internal-facing management job.

It’s a step up from an Engineering Manager role, not a bigger version of one. An EM owns a team. A Senior EM owns the system of teams: how they’re structured, how work flows between them, how the EMs leading them grow, and how the domain shows up to Product and the wider business. You’ll spend less time in any one team’s backlog and more time on the conditions that let several teams deliver well at once: resourcing, coaching, architectural alignment, and representing engineering credibly outside engineering.

The domain has real history and real constraints, not a green field: a mix of established and modernising systems, some legacy platforms alongside newer stacks, and teams at different levels of technical and operational maturity. You’ll be expected to form your own view of what’s working, what isn’t, and what needs to change, and to build the trust needed to act on it.

You’ll make decisions based on data, and help build a culture of measurement and continuous improvement.

**What you’ll be accountable for:**

**Teams & people**

* Coaching and developing the Engineering Managers (and senior/lead engineers) who report to you: their technical judgement, their people leadership, their career growth.
* Structuring and re-structuring teams as the work demands it, closing skill or capacity gaps and avoiding key-person dependencies rather than treating team shape as fixed.
* Holding a consistent, visible bar for what a high-performing team looks like across your domain, and addressing sustained under-performance directly rather than leaving it to individual EMs.
* Building a hiring and retention engine for the domain: enabling your EMs to hire well, and finding growth and mobility paths for strong engineers.

**Delivery**

* Being the first line of escalation for delivery and technical issues across your teams, arriving with context and a proposed path forward rather than just the problem.
* Coordinating effort across workstreams and delegating decisions to EMs with clear boundaries, then following through rather than disappearing after handoff.
* Partnering with Product and commercial stakeholders to define shared metrics, challenge scope and trade-offs, and keep teams aligned to a durable mission rather than reactive requests.
* Applying team-topology thinking (Conway’s Law and similar) to keep team boundaries and interaction patterns deliberate rather than accidental.

**Technical craft**

* Staying close enough to the technical detail to ask good questions and spot drift, without being hands-on: your leverage is through your EMs and senior engineers, not your own commits.
* Protecting space for quality against deadline pressure, and coaching your EMs to do the same with their teams.
* Driving the domain’s operational maturity (testing, observability, incident response) in partnership with teams rather than mandating from above.
* Building credible cases for structural or technical investment (replatforming, team re-formation, headcount) grounded in business need.

**Leadership**

* Representing your domain to peers, Product, commercial stakeholders, and senior leadership, and representing the wider engineering organisation’s priorities back into your domain.
* Operating as a genuine partner to senior stakeholders outside engineering, not just an escalation point they go through.
* Challenging the status quo constructively, including with more senior colleagues, and forming clear, evidence-based views you’re willing to be challenged on.
* Connecting your teams’ technical work to user and business outcomes.

## Requirements

* A track record of managing managers: you’ve led other Engineering Managers or equivalent senior technical leads, not just individual engineers, across a multi-team domain of comparable scale.
* Strong technical grounding: not hands-on day to day, but deep enough to hold a real technical conversation, sense-check architectural direction, and know when to step in, across a mix of legacy and modern systems.
* Evidence-based leadership: you use delivery and quality data to make decisions and build buy-in, including constructive challenge upward when the evidence supports it.
* Genuine partnership with Product and commercial stakeholders: you can speak fluently about business and user outcomes, not just engineering output, and operate credibly as a peer to non-engineering senior stakeholders.
* A coaching orientation: you develop people through delegation and follow-through, not by doing their job for them.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: you create clarity for your teams even where the domain itself is still being shaped.

Nice to have

* Experience in public sector, health, housing, or regulated environments.
* Experience leading through team re-structuring or organisational change.
* Exposure to legacy modernisation alongside greenfield delivery within the same portfolio.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering practices and how they change what “good” looks like for a team.
* Awareness of Developer Experience principles.
* Worked in an environment where engineers own production services.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams.

## Benefits

**Why You'll Love Working with Us**   
As a company, we're passionate about what we do and the citizens we serve. If you, too, want to champion the use of technology in public services to improve outcomes for citizens and public sector organizations, then Civica is the right place for you. We will help you unlock the best version of yourself, achieve career growth, and make a real difference to people and communities.

# Lead DevOps Engineer

Collinson is the global, privately-owned company dedicated to helping the world to travel with ease and confidence. The group offers a unique blend of industry and sector specialists who together provide market-leading airport experiences, loyalty and customer engagement, and insurance solutions for over 400 million consumers.   
  
Collinson is the operator of Priority Pass, the world’s original and leading airport experiences programme. Travellers can access a network of 1,500+ lounges and travel experiences, including dining, retail, sleep and spa, in over 650 airports in 148 countries, helping to elevate the journey into something special. We work with the world’s leading payment networks, over 1,400 banks, 90 airlines and 20 hotel groups worldwide.  
  
We have been bringing innovation to the market since inception – from launching the first independent global VIP lounge access Programme, Priority Pass to being the first to sell direct travel insurance in the UK through Columbus Direct and creating the first loyalty agency of its kind in the travel sector with ICLP. Today we still invest heavily in innovation to ensure that we continue to deliver superior customer experiences.  
  
Key clients include Mastercard, American Express, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, LATAM, Flying Blue, Accor, EasyJet, HSBC, Chase, HDFC.  
  
Our mission is focused on doing good beyond profit, which for us means we seek out opportunities for our people to share in our success and that we give back to the communities and people within which we work.  
  
Never short of ambition, the success of our business is delivered through the diverse and talented team of over 2,200 global colleagues.

**Lead DevOps Engineer**

**The Role**

As Lead DevOps Engineer, you'll own the design, reliability, scalability, security, and cost efficiency of our production platform - a zero-downtime, multi-region AWS environment running Kubernetes and serverless workloads and centralised AI enablement layers at scale. You'll set the technical direction for the DevOps team, driving and documenting the platform standards, practices, and tooling that champion DevEx, eases friction and keep our systems resilient and secure.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll architect and solve complex infrastructure challenges while mentoring and growing the engineers around you. You'll own our platform SLAs, serve as the platform advocate in cross-functional decisions, and act as the core authority on resilience, cost, security, and enablement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Platform Ownership** - Own the end-to-end reliability, stability, and performance of our production platform. Enforce SLAs across availability, security posture, and resilience. Drive the measures, thresholds, and incident response standards the team operates to.
* **Zero-Downtime Operations** - Run and maintain a multi-region, zero-downtime platform. Own deployment strategies (blue/green, canary), traffic management, and failover patterns that ensure continuous availability under change and failure.
* **Security & Compliance** - Own the platform's security posture end to end: networking controls, IAM, KMS, secrets management, vulnerability management, and compliance against frameworks such as PCI DSS v4 and CIS Benchmarks. Work closely with security teams and act as the DevOps authority on audit and risk.
* **DR & Business Continuity** - Participate in disaster recovery strategy, automation, execution and continuous improvement.
* **TCO & Cost Management** - Drive the strategy on platform total cost of ownership, providing teams with clear cost-allocation visibility. Drive rightsizing, tagging strategy and architectural decisions that balance cost against reliability and developer experience.
* **Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD** - Set and maintain the standards for IaC (Terraform, Terragrunt). Ensure deployments are secure, fast, and auditable. Raise the bar on automation so routine operational tasks are eliminated, not managed.
* **Observability** - Own the observability strategy across the platform using Datadog. Define what good looks like: SLO/SLA dashboards, alerting thresholds, runbooks, and the feedback loops that let teams act on signals before users feel them.
* **Team Leadership & Mentoring** - Lead and grow a team of DevOps engineers. Set technical direction, conduct design reviews, and create an environment where engineers take ownership. Actively mentor and develop less experienced engineers, helping them move from task execution to platform thinking.
* **AI & Automation** - Lead the team's adoption of AI-assisted operations - embedding AI into CI/CD pipelines, runbook automation, incident response, and developer tooling. Define where AI adds real leverage and own its safe integration into the platform.

**Your Experience**

* Deep expertise with AWS at scale: EKS (Automode), Lambda, EC2, RDS/Aurora, multi-region networking (VPC + Endpoints, Transit Gateway, Network Firewall, WAF, API Gateway), security services (IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, SCPs, Security Hub, GuardDuty) and AI tooling (Bedrock Agentcore).
* Proven ownership of a production-grade EKS platform with zero-downtime deployments - ArgoCD, Istio, blue/green and canary strategies are second nature.
* Terraform expert. You've set the IaC standards for a team, not just followed them.
* Automation & CI/CD - Be an authority on CI/CD pipelines to automate fast, secure and seamless deployments, with a strong emphasis on improving developer experience to automate routine tasks and improve operational efficiency.
* Experience embedding AI into SLDC workflows
* Hands-on DR experience: automated backup, multi-region/az failover, AWS FIS testing, and formal DR exercises with defined RTO/RPO targets.
* Familiarity with security - you've worked within a compliant environment, and you're comfortable in security audits and risk conversations. You're comfortable with security tooling such as CrowdStrike and Rapid7, SIEM/SOC.
* Observability ownership with Datadog (or equivalent) - you've defined SLOs, built the dashboards, and set the alerting culture.
* Experience leading or mentoring a DevOps team - you can set direction, manage technical debt conversations, and grow engineers.
* Comfortable with Python, Bash, Ansible, Helm, and GitHub Actions.

* **Run cross-squad alignment.** Surface dependencies before they become blockers. Own the mechanics of the operating rhythm (weekly delivery sync, monthly initiative review).

* **Own software quality and rigor as a process discipline:** test coverage, incident post-mortems, code review turnaround, deploy hygiene. You define these guidelines and make sure they land and stick.
* **Partner with the Product Team.** Sprint intake, scoping, feasibility, capacity conversations, mediation.
* **Build the aspiring Head of Engineering muscle:** learn the business, the customers, the product, and the strategic bets.

#### **⭐ You'll thrive in this role if you:**

* **Bring 8+ years of experience in software engineering with 3+ years managing engineering teams.**

* Educated to a degree level or equivalent

* Applied use of AI tools to enhance core workflows

* A team player spirit and an enthusiasm for working collaboratively

commitment to quality is adopted throughout the organization and sets the
foundation for delivering our full suite of capabilities.

### Job Description

**Enterprise Discovery Architect**

**Job Title**: Enterprise Discovery Architect

**Experience**: 5+ years

**Location**: Maidenhead, United Kingdom

**Job Type**: Full-time

**Role Overview**

VE3 is seeking an experienced Enterprise Discovery Architect to lead technology discovery engagements for complex digital transformation, modernisation and enterprise technology programmes.

The Enterprise Discovery Architect will work with senior client stakeholders to understand business objectives, assess existing technology landscapes, identify risks and opportunities, and translate discovery findings into clear architecture options, transformation roadmaps and executable delivery workstreams.

This is a client-facing role requiring a combination of broad technology knowledge, enterprise and solution architecture experience, consulting capability and strong workshop facilitation skills.

The successful candidate will be comfortable operating in situations where the client’s requirements, problems or future direction are not yet fully defined. They will be able to create clarity from ambiguity, ask intelligent and challenging questions, bring structure to complex discussions and help clients make informed technology decisions.

The role is not limited to producing architecture diagrams. It requires someone who can lead conversations across business, technology, data, security, operations, commercial and delivery teams, and convert those discussions into practical recommendations.

  

### Requirements

**Key Responsibilities**

**Discovery Planning and Leadership**

* Plan and lead client technology discovery engagements.
* Define the objectives, scope, stakeholders, agenda and expected outputs for discovery sessions.
* Design and facilitate workshops involving business leaders, technology teams, operational stakeholders, security specialists, product teams and third-party suppliers.
* Establish a structured discovery approach appropriate to the client, programme and level of maturity.
* Ensure that discovery activities remain focused on business outcomes rather than becoming technology-led discussions.
* Identify where further specialist input, evidence or technical investigation is required.
* Coordinate contributions from VE3 subject-matter experts across cloud, applications, data, integration, cybersecurity, AI and delivery.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Facilitation**

* Engage confidently with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, programme directors, enterprise architects, business leaders and operational teams.
* Facilitate discussions involving stakeholders with different priorities, perspectives and levels of technical understanding.
* Ask diagnostic, open and follow-up questions to identify root causes rather than accepting stated requirements at face value.
* Challenge assumptions constructively and professionally.
* Identify areas where stakeholder views, requirements or priorities conflict.
* Create a shared understanding of the current position, desired outcomes and decisions required.
* Ensure that quieter or less senior stakeholders have appropriate opportunities to contribute.
* Summarise and play back findings during workshops to confirm accuracy and alignment.
* Maintain control of workshop scope, timing and outcomes.

**Current-State Assessment**

* Assess the client’s current business and technology environment.
* Review applications, platforms, infrastructure, cloud services, data, integrations, identity, security and operational processes.
* Identify technology dependencies, duplication, fragmentation, technical debt and architectural constraints.
* Assess existing technology strategies, standards, roadmaps and investment commitments.
* Understand existing delivery models, support arrangements, supplier relationships and internal capabilities.
* Identify gaps in documentation, governance, ownership and decision-making.
* Evaluate the impact of legacy systems and unsupported or obsolete technologies.
* Assess non-functional considerations, including resilience, scalability, availability, performance, security and maintainability.

**Business and Capability Analysis**

* Understand the business drivers behind the proposed technology initiative.
* Identify expected outcomes, benefits, success measures and critical business capabilities.
* Map business needs to technology capabilities and enabling services.
* Identify user, customer and operational pain points.
* Explore current manual processes, workarounds and areas of inefficiency.
* Assess whether stated requirements reflect genuine business needs or predetermined solution preferences.
* Support capability mapping, value-stream analysis and operating-model discussions where appropriate.

**Architecture Development**

* Develop clear and proportionate architecture outputs based on discovery findings.
* Produce current-state and target-state architecture views.
* Develop context diagrams, ecosystem maps, application landscapes, integration maps and data-flow diagrams.
* Define high-level architecture principles and design considerations.
* Identify potential technology options and assess their relative advantages, risks and constraints.
* Develop transition architectures and phased transformation approaches.
* Ensure recommendations consider business, data, application, integration, infrastructure, security and operational architecture.
* Avoid premature product selection or detailed solution design where discovery evidence is insufficient.
* Clearly distinguish confirmed requirements, assumptions, recommendations and areas requiring further analysis.

**Technology Strategy and Roadmaps**

* Translate discovery findings into strategic technology recommendations.
* Develop prioritised roadmaps covering immediate improvements, medium-term modernisation and longer-term transformation.
* Separate tactical quick wins from strategic architecture changes.
* Identify delivery workstreams, dependencies, sequencing and decision points.
* Define practical next steps that can progress into architecture, procurement, proof-of-concept or implementation phases.
* Support clients in understanding the implications of different investment and delivery options.
* Consider technology choices in the context of cost, complexity, delivery risk, organisational readiness and long-term sustainability.

**Risk, Governance and Decision Support**

* Identify architectural, technical, delivery, security, commercial and operational risks.
* Maintain structured records of risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies and decisions.
* Support the establishment of appropriate architecture governance.
* Define areas requiring technical assurance or specialist review.
* Present options in a balanced and evidence-based manner.
* Help clients understand trade-offs between speed, cost, risk, flexibility and technical quality.
* Support decision-making without overstating certainty where evidence remains incomplete.

**Proposal and Pre-Sales Support**

* Support VE3 account, consulting and delivery teams during early-stage client engagements.
* Participate in client qualification and solution-shaping discussions.
* Help define discovery scopes, statements of work and engagement approaches.
* Contribute to proposals, presentations and tender responses.
* Develop high-level delivery approaches, workstream structures and indicative resource requirements.
* Support effort, timeline and cost estimation based on discovery findings.
* Identify opportunities where VE3 capabilities can address client needs.
* Ensure that recommendations remain client-led and are not shaped solely around predetermined VE3 services or products.

**Discovery Outputs and Documentation**

Produce clear, concise and client-ready deliverables, which may include:

* Discovery reports
* Executive summaries
* Current-state assessments
* Technology landscape reviews
* Business capability maps
* Stakeholder and user-needs summaries
* Current-state architecture diagrams
* Target-state architecture diagrams
* Integration and data-flow views
* Architecture principles
* Technology option assessments
* Risk and dependency registers
* Prioritised opportunity backlogs
* Transformation roadmaps
* Delivery workstream definitions
* Indicative delivery plans
* High-level resource models
* Recommendations for subsequent phases

**Technology Coverage**

The Enterprise Discovery Architect is expected to have broad understanding across a wide technology landscape. Deep specialist expertise in every area is not required, but the successful candidate must understand how the different domains interact and when specialist support is needed.

Relevant areas include:

* Enterprise and solution architecture
* Cloud platforms, including Microsoft Azure, AWS and Google Cloud
* Hybrid and multi-cloud environments
* Enterprise applications
* ERP, CRM and line-of-business platforms
* Custom application development
* Legacy application modernisation
* SaaS, COTS and low-code platforms
* API management and systems integration
* Event-driven and service-oriented architecture
* Data platforms, analytics and business intelligence
* Data governance, quality, lineage and master data
* Artificial intelligence, machine learning and automation
* Identity and access management
* Cybersecurity, privacy and compliance
* DevOps, DevSecOps and platform engineering
* Containers, Kubernetes and infrastructure as code
* Enterprise service management and support models
* Observability, monitoring and operational resilience
* Digital workplace and collaboration platforms
* Technology operating models and governance

**Essential Experience**

* Significant experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, technology consulting or digital transformation.
* Demonstrable experience leading technology discovery or assessment engagements.
* Experience planning and facilitating workshops with senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Experience working across multiple architecture domains rather than within a single technology specialism.
* Experience assessing complex and fragmented technology environments.
* Experience developing current-state and target-state architecture.
* Experience translating business objectives into technology capabilities and architecture recommendations.
* Experience producing technology strategies, roadmaps and option assessments.
* Experience presenting findings and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Experience working in environments where requirements are incomplete, ambiguous or contested.
* Experience collaborating with specialist architects, engineers, security teams, data teams and delivery leads.
* Experience contributing to proposals, statements of work, bids or pre-sales activities.
* Strong written communication and client-facing documentation skills.

**Essential Skills and Capabilities**

**Architecture and Technology**

* Broad understanding of modern enterprise technology.
* Strong enterprise and solution architecture capability.
* Ability to connect business, data, application, integration, infrastructure and security considerations.
* Ability to develop clear architecture models without unnecessary complexity.
* Understanding of cloud adoption, modernisation and migration approaches.
* Understanding of technical debt, legacy constraints and transition architecture.
* Ability to evaluate technology options objectively.
* Understanding of non-functional requirements and operational considerations.
* Ability to identify when a specialist architect or technical expert is required.

**Consulting and Discovery**

* Strong questioning, listening and analytical skills.
* Ability to identify root causes, dependencies and hidden constraints.
* Ability to structure complex and ambiguous information.
* Ability to distinguish business needs from preferred technology solutions.
* Ability to synthesise large amounts of information quickly.
* Ability to create a clear narrative from conflicting stakeholder inputs.
* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking capability.
* Commercial awareness and understanding of how recommendations affect cost, risk and delivery.

**Workshop Facilitation**

* Strong facilitation and presentation skills.
* Ability to establish authority and credibility in senior client environments.
* Ability to manage difficult, dominant or conflicting stakeholders.
* Ability to keep workshops focused and outcome-driven.
* Ability to adapt facilitation style to different audiences.
* Ability to explain complex technology concepts in accessible language.
* Ability to manage time, scope and expectations effectively.
* Ability to summarise decisions and actions clearly.

**Communication**

* Excellent verbal and written English.
* Strong executive communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to produce concise, high-quality client deliverables.
* Ability to present recommendations without overstating certainty.
* Ability to challenge constructively while maintaining positive stakeholder relationships.

**Desirable Experience**

* Experience working for a technology consultancy, systems integrator or professional-services organisation.
* Experience in regulated or public-sector environments.
* Experience with UK government, healthcare, financial services, utilities, education, housing or other complex enterprise environments.
* Experience with formal enterprise architecture practices or frameworks.
* Experience supporting procurement, tendering or technology partner selection.
* Experience with service design, product discovery or business architecture.
* Experience developing business cases or investment options.
* Experience supporting major cloud, ERP, CRM, data, integration or cybersecurity transformation programmes.
* Experience assessing AI readiness, data maturity or automation opportunities.
* Experience working with delivery teams through the transition from discovery into implementation.

**Qualifications and Certifications**

Relevant qualifications or certifications may include:

* TOGAF
* BCS Enterprise and Solution Architecture
* ArchiMate
* AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud architecture certifications
* ITIL
* SAFe
* Scrum or Agile certifications
* Business analysis or service-design qualifications
* Security architecture or cloud-security certifications

Qualifications are desirable but will not replace demonstrable experience in leading successful client discovery engagements.

**Personal Attributes**

* The successful candidate will be:
* Confident but not overbearing
* Curious and analytical
* Comfortable with uncertainty
* Structured and methodical
* Commercially aware
* Client-focused
* Pragmatic rather than theoretical
* Able to challenge respectfully
* Comfortable working across multiple technology domains
* Able to build trust quickly
* Able to remain neutral when assessing technology options
* Able to operate independently while collaborating effectively with wider teams
* Honest about areas requiring specialist expertise
* Focused on producing actionable outcomes rather than documentation for its own sake

**​****About VE3**

VE3 is a technology and digital services organisation delivering complex transformation, cloud, data, application, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence and managed-service programmes.

We work with clients to understand complex business and technology challenges, develop practical transformation strategies and deliver secure, scalable and sustainable solutions.

Our consulting approach is outcome-led, technology-informed and evidence-based. We expect our architects and consultants to understand the client’s real problem before recommending a solution.

### Job Description

**Head of Public Sector Legal & Contracts**

**Job Title**: Head of Public Sector Legal & Contracts

**Experience**: 5+ years

**Location**: Maidenhead, United Kingdom

**Job Type**: Full-time

**Role overview**

VE3 is seeking an experienced public sector contracts lawyer to lead the legal and contractual management of its UK public sector portfolio.

The role will provide practical legal advice across the full contract lifecycle, including tender review, contract negotiation, mobilisation, contract delivery, variations, disputes, renewals and exit.

Strong knowledge of UK public procurement law is required, but only from the perspective of advising VE3 as a supplier. The role will not advise contracting authorities on procurement routes, procurement strategy or tender design.

The successful candidate will act as VE3’s principal legal adviser for public sector contracts and will coordinate external legal counsel where specialist support is required.

  

### Requirements

**Key responsibilities**

**Contract review and negotiation**

* Review and negotiate public sector framework agreements, call-off contracts, statements of work, managed service agreements and contract schedules.
* Advise on liability, indemnities, warranties, insurance, intellectual property, data protection, confidentiality, audit, termination, exit and TUPE provisions.
* Prepare clear legal-risk summaries and recommendations for senior leadership.
* Ensure agreed clarifications, assumptions and negotiated positions are reflected in the final contract.

**Tender and pre-contract legal support**

* Review material tender and contract documentation before submission.
* Identify legal risks, mandatory obligations and potentially onerous commitments.
* Review supplier declarations, subcontracting arrangements and contractual qualifications.
* Check that VE3’s tender response does not create unintended or unsupported commitments.
* Maintain a legal-risk and exceptions register for significant bids.

**Supplier-side procurement law**

* Interpret public procurement requirements where they affect VE3 as a bidder or supplier.
* Review framework, call-off and tender documentation.
* Advise on inconsistencies between procurement documents, clarification responses, VE3’s bid and the final contract.
* Review standstill correspondence, evaluation feedback and supplier declarations.
* Advise on exclusion, debarment and disclosure risks.
* Assess the legal implications of contract variations, extensions and scope changes.
* Coordinate external procurement-law advice where a formal challenge or specialist opinion is required.

**Contract support during delivery**

* Produce practical contract summaries for delivery and account teams.
* Interpret contractual obligations, dependencies, acceptance criteria and notice requirements.
* Advise whether requested work is within scope or requires a formal change.
* Review material client instructions and contractual correspondence.
* Prevent operational decisions from unintentionally varying the contract or waiving VE3’s rights.

**Variations, notices and disputes**

* Review contract variations, extensions, renewals and amendments.
* Ensure material changes are properly documented and approved.
* Draft or review breach, delay, remediation, dispute and termination notices.
* Monitor contractual deadlines and preserve VE3’s rights.
* Lead the internal legal management of contractual disputes.
* Prepare legal assessments, event chronologies and settlement recommendations.
* Manage instructions to external solicitors and counsel.

**Intellectual property, data and technology contracts**

* Protect VE3’s background intellectual property, platforms, accelerators, software and reusable components.
* Distinguish VE3-owned materials from client-specific deliverables.
* Review software licensing, cloud, data, artificial intelligence and open-source provisions.
* Review data-processing, confidentiality, information-security and freedom of information clauses.
* Ensure VE3 has appropriate intellectual-property rights from employees, consultants and subcontractors.

**TUPE and subcontracting**

* Review TUPE schedules, employee-transfer information and workforce indemnities.
* Coordinate specialist employment-law advice where required.
* Draft and negotiate subcontractor, consultant and partner agreements.
* Ensure relevant client obligations are appropriately flowed down.
* Identify gaps between VE3’s client commitments and supplier or subcontractor obligations.

**Legal governance**

* Maintain a central register of public sector contracts, variations, notices and disputes.
* Establish proportionate legal-review and approval processes.
* Develop standard contract-review templates, subcontracting terms and legal precedents.
* Provide contract and legal-risk training to bid, account, transition and delivery teams.
* Coordinate the use of external legal advisers.

**Candidate profile**

**Essential**

* Solicitor qualified in England and Wales, or equivalent relevant legal qualification.
* Significant experience reviewing and negotiating UK public sector contracts.
* Experience advising a technology, professional services, outsourcing or managed-services supplier.
* Strong contract-law, drafting and negotiation skills.
* Practical knowledge of UK public procurement law as it affects suppliers.
* Experience with framework and call-off contracts.
* Experience handling contract variations, notices and disputes.
* Strong knowledge of liability, indemnities, intellectual property, data protection and confidentiality.
* Experience advising senior business and delivery stakeholders.
* Ability to provide practical, proportionate and commercially aware legal advice.

**Desirable**

* Experience with Crown Commercial Service or other public sector frameworks.
* Experience in central government, local government, NHS, defence or regulated sectors.
* Experience with technology, cloud, data, cybersecurity, software or artificial intelligence contracts.
* Experience with TUPE, supplier exclusion and debarment matters.
* Previous in-house experience with a public sector technology supplier or systems integrator.

**Skills and behaviours**

* The successful candidate will demonstrate:
* Strong legal judgement
* Clear and concise communication
* Practical risk-based decision-making
* Excellent drafting and negotiation
* Confidence working with senior stakeholders
* The ability to challenge constructively
* Strong organisation and attention to detail
* The ability to protect VE3’s position without taking an unnecessarily adversarial approach

**Head of Finance Business Partnering – Growth Markets**

**Location: Hybrid ways of working at office in Wimbledon**

**Contract: Permanent**

**Salary: Competitive**

We have a fantastic opportunity for a Head of Finance Business Partnering – EU Growth Markets to join our Group Finance team. The Head of Finance Business Partnering – Growth Markets / US will lead financial business partnering across the Growth Markets regions in the EU, supporting delivery of financial performance, strategic priorities and business objectives. 

The role acts as a trusted finance partner to regional and market leadership teams, providing financial insight, challenge and decision support to drive profitable growth and effective resource allocation. Working closely with the Regional Finance Director and business leaders, the role ensures robust planning, forecasting and performance management processes while maintaining strong financial discipline.

The role is responsible for leading the Finance Business Partnering team supporting the region, enabling high-quality decision making through forward-looking analysis, commercial insight and performance evaluation.  

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Lead financial business partnering activities across the Growth Markets region
* Partner with regional and market leadership teams to support delivery of financial and operational objectives.
* Provide proactive financial insight, challenge and recommendations to support business decision-making.
* Lead budgeting, forecasting and planning activities across supported markets and functions.
* Drive performance management processes, ensuring leaders understand key financial drivers, risks and opportunities.
* Provide robust financial challenge on commercial initiatives, investment decisions and strategic priorities.
* Support development and evaluation of business cases, including financial modelling and benefits tracking.
* Deliver forward-looking analysis and scenario planning to inform strategic decisions.
* Partner with business leaders to identify revenue growth, productivity and cost optimisation opportunities.
* Ensure alignment with Group planning, forecasting and governance frameworks.
* Collaborate with FP&A, Financial Control, Treasury and Shared Services teams to deliver consistent financial reporting and insight.
* Support execution of transformation initiatives and change programmes within the region.
* Build financial capability and commercial understanding across leadership teams.
* Lead and develop regional Finance Business Partners, driving capability, engagement and performance.
* Drive continuous improvement in reporting, planning and business partnering processes.

**What you’ll bring:**

* Significant experience in commercial finance, FP&A or finance business partnering.
* Strong understanding of financial planning, forecasting and performance management.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and provide effective challenge.
* Experience supporting commercial and operational decision-making.
* Strong analytical capability with experience in financial modelling and scenario analysis.
* Experience working within matrix organisations and collaborating across functions.
* Understanding of governance, controls and financial management disciplines.
* Ability to balance strategic priorities with operational delivery in a fast-paced environment.
* Professional finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent)
* Scope typically covers a regional or market P&L and associated functional cost bases.

**We offer lots of great benefits! Some of which include:**

* Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus
* 25 days annual leave plus bank/public holidays, as well as an annual option to buy up to 5 additional days of annual leave
* Training opportunities as well as clearly defined career progression
* Health cash plan – employer funded cover to enable you to claim money back on essential healthcare costs, including dental, optical, physiotherapy and many more.  Cover also includes unlimited access to a 24/7 virtual GP service
* Attractive company pension scheme
* Life assurance – employer funded cover of 4x basic salary
* Dedicated online benefit portal offering access to saving and lending facilities, financial wellbeing and support services:

* Salary Finance – access to savings and borrowing through payroll
* Car Leasing – access to a carbon neutral salary sacrifice car leasing scheme, with an all-inclusive monthly cost covering all charge, taxes, insurance, repairs and maintenance on a range of brand-new vehicles
* Travel Loans – interest free loans to help spread the cost of annual travel tickets
* Cycle to Work – tax efficient bike and cycling equipment worth up to £1,000

* Health & Wellbeing – discounted gym membership, online virtual workout sessions, online culinary classes
* OnHand – Giving you the opportunity to be an Eco & Social volunteer via a handy app. Volunteer individually or in groups to get involved in Youth Mentoring, Food Poverty, Homelessness & Elderly help.
* Employee Assistance Programme – specialist advice and support on issues such as finance, relationships, illness and family issues
* Free Domestic & General protection plan – one free plan each year with access to discounted rates of up to 50% on additional plans, including referrals for family and friends
* Employee discounts – with a range of discounts for 100s of online and high street retailers

**Domestic & General are an equal opportunities employer which means we treat people fairly. We welcome applications from all suitably skilled persons regardless of their gender, age, race, disability, ethnic background, religion/belief, sexual orientation, gender reassignment or marital/family status.**

**Please note that we have a thorough referencing process, which includes criminal record checks.**

**Welcome to the Pathogen Program:**

Within this ecosystem, the Pathogen Program exemplifies EIT's dedication to ground-breaking science. It seeks to transform pathogen risk management, detection and response by leveraging Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS)-based metagenomic and pathogen-specific analytical tools. The goal is to power metagenomic devices using long-read sequencing technologies by building a comprehensive database of pathogen information to inform response. The database will comprise >400,00 paired high-quality long read sequences with comprehensive antimicrobial susceptibility profiles. Enabled by Oracle Inc.'s cloud-computing scale and security, the Pathogen Program is advancing toward certified diagnostic tools for deployment in laboratories, hospitals, and public health organisations worldwide.

**Your Role:**

We are looking for a Senior Scientist with expertise in AMR genomics to join the Pathogen Program. This is a predominantly desk-based role working collaboratively across teams within the Pathogen Program to provide expert input on a range of AMR related tasks and topics. You will curate expert rules for interpretation of AMR genotypic data, provide domain-specific analysis and support for genome sequence and AST data generated by the laboratory, provide expert advice for AST testing and investigate putative novel mechanisms of resistance.

This is an excellent opportunity for an enthusiastic individual with a passion for AMR and strong domain-specific knowledge to contribute to an ambitious program of work aiming to revolutionise pathogen diagnostics.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide expert knowledge and input into research and operational activities involving antimicrobials and AMR.

# Safeguarding Case Management Group Independent Member

United Kingdom

## Job Description

*The Rugby Football Union (RFU) are seeking a Safeguarding Case Management Group Independent Member to join the The Safeguarding Case Management Group (SCMG) in volunteer capacity.*

**Volunteer Opportunity: Safeguarding Case Management Group Independent Member**

* **Role Type:** Volunteer appointment
* **Anticipated Commitment:** Approximately 8 hours per month, including meeting preparation and urgent case consultations
* **Location:** Primarily virtual (via Microsoft Teams), with occasional attendance at Allianz Stadium
* **Expenses:** Reasonable expenses reimbursed
* **Accountable to:** Chair of the Safeguarding Case Management Group

**Application information:**

* Please submit an anonymised CV (i.e. remove personal details) or an expression of interest.
* Vacancy closing date: **Friday 14th August 2026 17:00PM**
* Shortlisted applicants will be invited to participate in an interview via Microsoft Teams

**Nature and scope:**

Everyone involved in rugby is important and we take our responsibility for their welfare and wellbeing seriously. We want the rugby environment to be a safe and happy one.

The Safeguarding Case Management Group (SCMG) is a cross departmental group charged by the RFU with assessing the risk that individuals may pose to children and adults at risk.

The SCMG consider concerns or referrals presented by the RFU Safeguarding Team and decide on the appropriate outcome following any investigation, including those by police, social care or any other regulatory agency. Information is considered on a paper-based basis and decisions made using a risk-based approach and the balance of probabilities standard.

The SCMG also consider information disclosed on a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) certificate and assess whether the applicant is potentially suitable or is deemed a risk to children or adults at risk.

SCMG members are expected to balance the rights of individuals against the RFU's responsibility to safeguard children and adults at risk, ensuring decisions are fair, proportionate, evidence-based and focused on welfare and safety.

It is essential that the SCMG brings together a wide range of perspectives from both within our sport and outside of it.

We're looking to extend our current complement of expertise and invite applications from individuals who wish to volunteer to use their personal and professional skills, experience and judgement to ensure that Rugby Union in England is safe for children and adults at risk.

Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $100M+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.**

Money moves through Fanvue in three directions every day: fans paying in, acquirers settling to our banks, and creators being paid out what they have earned. At our scale, across a multi-acquirer stack and multiple currencies, proving that all of it happened correctly is a discipline in its own right. That is what this role owns.

## 🎯 The Role

We're hiring a **Payments & Treasury Analyst** to own continuous reconciliation of money movement across the platform, reporting directly to our VP Finance with a dotted line into Operations.

This is a Finance controls role. Operations runs the payment rails. You prove the money moved, every day, independently. The distinction matters and it is the whole point of the job.

Today reconciliation happens periodically. Your job is to make it constant and owned. We are building the ledger and matching tooling in parallel, so the mechanical matching will be automated. What automation cannot do is own the exceptions daily and apply payments judgement: reading an acquirer statement and spotting a fee that does not match the agreement, or knowing whether a settlement gap is a weekend cycle or a genuine break. That judgement is why this is a specialist hire rather than generalist finance headcount.

You will be doing live reconciliation work from week one. There is no synthetic onboarding period.

## 🚀 What You'll Do

* Own the daily acquirer to bank reconciliation across our full acquirer estate
* Stand up and run independent daily monitoring of creator payouts against earnings owed, so no payout moves without reconciliation behind it
* Publish a weekly reconciled percentage per leg to Finance, and keep an exceptions queue that gets worked rather than just logged
* Validate acquirer fees against every merchant services agreement and recover variances
* Map FX exposure across settlement vendors and optimise cash held across our outbound rails
* Sit as Finance's independent second-line voice in our Payments Risk forum
* Turn payments in and payouts out into one standing daily process rather than two separate scrambles

## 👀 Who You Are

* From fintech, payments or payment processing. This one is non-negotiable, because it is not trainable on the job
* Experience of marketplace or platform-scale payments environments is a strong bonus
* You read acquirer statements natively and have an instinct for when a number is wrong before you can prove why
* You treat reconciliation as an owned daily discipline, not a monthly report
* Comfortable being the person who says the numbers do not agree, and then finding out why
* Confident working across multiple currencies, settlement cycles and providers
* Some treasury exposure, or the appetite to take it on. FX and cash optimisation are part of this role from day 31 onwards
* Happy to own something end to end rather than contribute to someone else's process

## ✨ You'll Thrive Here If

* You want to build a discipline rather than inherit one
* You would rather prove something than report it
* You like being the independent check, and are comfortable with the friction that sometimes brings
* You want direct access to a VP Finance and real influence on how controls get designed

## ⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

* You want a monthly close rhythm and a predictable calendar
* You need the process to already exist before you arrive
* You would rather escalate an unexplained difference than chase it down yourself
* You want to stay purely in reporting and away from operational detail

# Construction Site Manager

Your Mission

The Construction Site Manager plays a pivotal role in delivering the safe, efficient, and high-quality construction of a 200MW/800MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) project. The position is focused on overseeing all site-based activities, ensuring works are executed in line with design specifications, programme requirements, and construction best practices, while effectively managing contractors, resources, and interfaces on site.

This role is central to driving construction performance, maintaining strict control of health and safety, quality, and productivity throughout all phases of the build. It supports the successful progression from early works through to commissioning by proactively managing site risks, resolving technical and logistical challenges, and fostering a disciplined, delivery-focused culture that ensures the project is completed on time, within budget, and to the highest construction standards.

## Key Responsibilities

What you’ll be doing

As a Construction Site Manager, you will take full responsibility for the day to day management of site activities, ensuring all works are delivered safely, efficiently, and in line with the project programme and technical requirements. You will work directly with the Project Management Team maintaining clear oversight of progress, productivity, and quality across all construction phases.

This is a broad and varied role with the opportunity to have massive impact. Key responsibilities include:

* Take full responsibility for the day-to-day management of all on-site construction activities;
* Enforce high standards of health, safety, and environmental compliance across site;
* Act as the primary on-site point of contact for project managers, engineers, and stakeholders;
* Liaise and support the Principal Contractor (PC) to coordinate and supervise contractors, subcontractors, and trades across multiple work fronts ensuring alignment with Employers Requirements and contractual commitments;
* Support and oversee PC ensuring that planning and sequence on site works ensure efficient delivery in line with the project programmes;
* Collaborate and support PC for the effective management of site logistics, including access, materials, plant, and resource allocation;
* Oversee civil, electrical, and mechanical installations, ensuring alignment with design specifications and contractual obligations;
* Monitor progress against key milestones and take proactive action to mitigate delays;
* Lead site briefings, watching briefs (as required), inspections, and audits, addressing risks and non-conformances promptly;
* Ensure quality control processes are followed, including inspections, testing, and documentation;
* Facilitate clear communication between all parties to resolve technical and logistical issues;
* Track and report on site performance, productivity, and programme status;
* Drive a culture of accountability, teamwork, and high performance on site;
* Ensure the project is delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest construction standards

Key Accountabilities

**QHSE Leadership**

* Lead a “safety-first” culture and verify compliance with CDM arrangements, site rules, RAMS, Safe Systems of Work (SSOW) and Permits-to-Work (PTW).
* Oversee high-risk activities: lifting plans (containers/transformers), excavations/temporary works, electrical isolations, switching coordination, hot works, working at height, confined spaces (this is not an exhaustive list).
* Ensure robust controls for BESS hazards: thermal runaway mitigation, separation/segregation, ventilation and gas detection, fire strategy implementation, emergency response plan and drills, and site access protocols for containers.
* Maintain environmental and community controls: noise/dust, traffic management, waste, spill prevention, drainage protection and planning condition compliance.

**Construction Oversight on both BOP and BESS**

* Verify work is delivered to IFC drawings/specs, ITPs, hold points, and OEM installation requirements.
* Focus on critical quality risks:
  + BOP: civils tolerances, duct banks, cable pulls/bending radii, gland/termination workmanship, earthing continuity/resistance, P&C wiring/labels, enclosure ingress protection.
  + BESS: container placement/tolerances, HVAC commissioning prerequisites, fire system installation integrity, comms/SCADA networks, auxiliary power reliability, OEM checklists completion.
* Raise/track NCRs and drive corrective actions to reduce rework and protect schedule.

**Programme, Progress & Interface Control**

* Track daily progress against schedule and 2 week lookaheads across both BESS and BOP workflows
* Identify constraints early and propose mitigations.
* Attend coordination meetings and ensure decisions/actions are closed out with clear owners and dates.

**Contractor Governance and Change Control**

* Act as Fields focal point for site decisions within delegated authority; escalate risks and commercial impacts promptly.
* Manage interfaces between EPC, BESS OEM, BOP contractors, TO, commissioning teams, and third parties (telecoms, security, metering).
* Support change control by spotting scope deviations and ensuring approvals are documented and implemented correctly.

### **Commissioning, energisation & handover readiness**

* Support pre-commissioning and commissioning activities: walkdowns, test witnessing, SAT coordination, and system integration checks (BESS–EMS–SCADA–P&C).
* Coordinate energisation readiness packs: switching plans, competencies, documentation completeness, emergency arrangements, and contingency plans.
* Drive handover deliverables: punch list closure evidence, test packs, as-builts, O&M manuals, spares/warranties, training records, and completion dossiers for Operations.

### **Stakeholder management & site stewardship**

* Maintain a tidy, audit-ready site; host visits and manage close-out of findings.
* Support landowner/community engagement and ensure issues are logged, responded to, and closed out.
* Ensure compliance with planning conditions and local constraints.

**Key Deliverables**

* Daily site diary and weekly progress/QHSE report (with photos).
* Integrated BESS/BOP interface log, risk register inputs, and constraints tracker
* Punch list / snag register (prioritised and evidenced close-out)
* Commissioning & energisation readiness (“go/no-go”) packs
* Handover dossier support: test results, certificates, as-builts, training and spares lists

## Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

The skills you’ll need

**Essential:**

* Proven site-based delivery experience on UK energy infrastructure with exposure to BESS and/or HV BOP works.
* Strong understanding of construction sequencing across civils + electrical + controls/SCADA.
* Solid grasp of CDM 2015, RAMS, PTW, and contractor management.
* High-quality reporting and a completion-focused mindset (evidence-based sign-off).
* Confident communicator able to challenge poor practice safely and professionally.
* Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel
* Demonstrable experience in reviewing Quality related documentation including QMP, ITP and raising NCRs

**Desirable:**

* Direct experience with BESS OEM packages (PCS/inverters, EMS, container systems, fire strategy integration).
* SMSTS/SSSTS; IOSH/NEBOSH.
* Familiarity with TO interface processes and grid compliance context (e.g., G99).
* AP/SAP experience (depending on owner model and project arrangements).

**Core Competencies:**

* Strong operational focus with a practical approach to safety and risk management.
* Ability to influence, coach, and engage teams across all levels.
* Proactive mindset with attention to detail and follow-through.
* Commitment to continuous improvement and building an open, learning culture.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills at all level

**Qualifications / certifications**

* Engineering or electrical qualification (apprenticeship/HNC/HND/degree) or equivalent experience;
* CSCS/ECS (as applicable)
* First Aid at Work (preferred)

**Working Pattern and Location:** Full time at site in Hartlepool with flexibility for extended hours during critical works, commissioning periods and energisation windows.

## Seller Acquisition Across 21 Markets

Its remit runs from awareness through sign-up, so the work spans the early demand stage and the point at which a prospective seller joins the marketplace. The function also covers market prioritisation, channel planning and the measurement of seller-growth activity.

The Head of Seller Demand sets the acquisition approach across more than 19 languages and coordinates work for international markets. The role uses third-party data, localisation and targeting to improve the quality of the seller pipeline. The vacancy asks for experience across multiple markets, with marketplace, SaaS or ecommerce work listed as desirable.
