**Head of  Impact and Governance (The Pret Foundation)** 

 

We’re Pret: proud makers of freshly made food, organic coffee, and big ideas. Across 750+ shops and 20+ countries, our teams are shaping the future of Pret through innovation, inclusion, great customer service and a shared passion for doing the right thing.  

 

Doing the right thing has always been central to Pret’s values. At the heart of this commitment is The Pret Foundation, a registered charity, established over 30 years ago with a simple but powerful mission: to alleviate hunger and help tackle homelessness. To date we have donated millions of meals to those who need it most, supported over 1,000 people into employment, and granted £7.5m+ to grassroots organisations. In 2023 we also partnered with Homewards, an initiative set up by HRH Prince William to demonstrate that homelessness in the UK is not inevitable. 

 

**What we’re looking for** 

With a third of the UK’s population living pay cheque to pay cheque, many are just one step away from homelessness. As we launch our new strategy, which will focus on stable routes out of homelessness through employment, skills, and entrepreneurship, the Head of Impact and Governance is a pivotal leadership role.  You will be responsible for ensuring the Foundation operates effectively, efficiently and with accountability, while developing a robust approach to impact measurement and performance.  

 

The successful candidate will create our first impact and evaluation framework to better articulate the impact of our work, drive our ongoing strategy refinement through clear decision making and focus on continuous improvement. Alongside this you will lead on operational functions including data governance, compliance and financial management, enabling the team to build strong foundations. This role is ideal for someone who loves to work with others, enjoys combining strategic thinking with practical implementation and is excited by the opportunity to build systems and frameworks from the ground up. 

 

**Key responsibilities** 

**Impact & Evaluation (30%)** 

* Develop and implement the Foundation’s impact measurement and evaluation strategy, establishing clear outcomes, performance indicators and reporting processes to measure the effectiveness of programmes and demonstrate impact

* Lead the collection, analysis and interpretation of data to assess programme effectiveness and organisation impact and to identify trends, opportunities and risks

**Data & Reporting (40%)** 

* Working alongside Pret’s Tech team, act as organisational lead for Foundation’s data systems to oversee system development, improve data quality, streamline processes, and ensure reliable reporting that support effective programme delivery, and informed decision-making.

* Produce high-quality impact report for trustees and other stakeholders, embedding a culture of evidence, learning and continuous improvement

* Ensure accurate and consistent data capture, management and reporting across programmes

* Develop reporting frameworks and dashboards that provide timely performance insights

* Act as operational lead for data protection, ensuring compliance with GDPR and relevant legislation

 

**Operations & Governance (15%)** 

* Responsible for charity law and regulation compliance, supporting the Finance & Governance Manager to develop and maintain policies, procedures and controls that support day to day delivery and long-term scaling

* Support organisational planning, risk management and governance processes

* Lead planning and reporting for Board and other leadership meetings

 

**Financial Management & Compliance (10%)** 

* Support Finance & Governance Manager with financial forecasting, budget planning and resource allocation

* Support Finance & Governance Manager to monitor organisation and programme budgets

* From 2027 onwards as new fundraising strategy is implemented, coordinate grant reporting and ensure compliance with funder requirements where appropriate

* Oversee basic HR administration and people processes

 

**Leadership and Relationship Management (5%)** 

* Contribute as a member of the senior leadership team of the Foundation, offering opinions and solutions outside of their immediate span of control. As a small team you will also get stuck in and support with tasks outside of your immediate remit where required.

* Hold regular 121s with Finance & Governance Manager, and conduct mid-year and end of year reviews to develop plans and ensure targets are met

* Build and nurture trusted relationships with internal teams, trustees, beneficiaries, and external partners to unify efforts and drive the delivery of our charitable strategy

 

**Experience and Skills required** 

* Significant experience in monitoring and evaluation: designing and launching new database systems and developing reporting frameworks that track impact and drive continuous improvement

* Desirable experience of monitoring budgets and ensuring compliance

* Knowledge of GDPR and data governance requirements

* Experience managing multiple priorities in fast paced environment

* Experience managing system implementation or transformation projects

* Desirable experience within charity, supporting employment, skills or youth focused programmes

* Desirable experience working cross functions in corporate environment, influencing variety of stakeholders

And when you’re not, you can use your Gold Card to get up to 5 Barista-made drinks a day, and 50% off everything else (food, snacks, bottled drinks – the lot).

**ABOUT RETOOL**

Nearly every company in the world runs on custom software for critical operations like tracking performance metrics, handling support workflows, building admin dashboards, and countless processes you might never have thought of. But most companies don't have the resources to properly invest in these tools, leading to a lot of old, clunky internal software, or worse, teams still stuck in manual and spreadsheet workflows.

AI has changed who gets to build software. The definition of "developer" now includes analysts, operators, and domain experts creating solutions directly—and the tools they reach for are multiplying by the week. That's both an opportunity and a challenge: as more people build with more AI tools, the risk of shipping ungoverned software into production grows just as fast.

At Retool, we're building the platform that makes all of it safe to ship. Build with any AI tool you want, then deploy into one place that connects to your real business data, enforces enterprise policies automatically, and lets teams create once and reuse everywhere with shared, trusted components. The cost of building software has collapsed. The cost of governing it hasn't—and that's the problem we solve.

Developers and domain experts have already automated over 100 million hours of work on our platform, freeing them to focus on creative problem-solving and strategic work that drives real business value. # Malware Reverse Engineer - Android - UK

**About Reversec**

At Reversec, we deliver research-led cyber security services that help organisations defend against real-world threats and build long-term resilience. Our consultants are a diverse team of highly skilled technical experts, researchers, and creative problem-solvers who are passionate about advancing the cyber security industry.

We believe great consultants are empowered consultants. Our people take ownership of their professional development, contribute to meaningful research, and have the freedom to shape the way we work. If you're driven by curiosity, enjoy solving complex technical challenges, and thrive in an environment that values innovation and continuous learning, we'd love to hear from you.

**The Role**

Reversec is a specialist security consultancy built on deep technical expertise, research, and real-world security engineering. Our consultants regularly analyse highly obfuscated software, reverse engineer complex applications, develop custom tooling, and contribute to open-source security projects used throughout the industry. Reversec maintains Android security tooling such as Drozer and invests heavily in research-led capability development.

We are seeking Android reverse engineers and malware analysts across all experience levels (from those building their skills to seasoned experts) to join a specialist team supporting one of the world's largest technology platforms.

As an Android Malware Reverse Engineering Analyst, you will investigate complex and evasive Android applications, identify malicious functionality, conduct detailed reverse engineering, and support automated detection development.

You will work as part of a specialist malware analysis team responsible for investigating applications that fall outside standard analysis processes and require advanced technical expertise. This includes malware research, incident investigations, escalation handling, detection engineering, and quality assurance activities.

We're recruiting analysts across multiple career stages, from aspiring reverse engineers to experienced malware researchers. Your responsibilities and the expectations placed on you will depend directly on the experience you bring. Experienced analysts will take on complex samples and investigations with a high degree of independence, provide mentorship to junior team members, and assist in developing internal tooling and processes. Analysts earlier in their careers will carry out similar categories of work, with closer support and a remit that grows as their skills develop. Wherever you start, training will be available to bring you up to the standard the team works to.

**Key Responsibilities**

All analysts contribute across the areas below. The complexity of the cases assigned to you, the degree of independence expected of you, and any additional oversight and reporting duties will reflect your experience.

**Malware Reverse Engineering**

* Perform detailed static and dynamic analysis of Android applications and SDKs.
* Analyse heavily obfuscated Java/Kotlin applications, native code, and framework applications (e.g., Flutter, .NET MAUI, React Native).
* Investigate packers, in-memory loading techniques, encrypted payloads and anti-analysis mechanisms.
* Determine application behaviour and identify potentially harmful functionality.

**Investigation & Incident Response**

* Conduct complex investigations into suspicious applications and malware campaigns.
* Support escalations and urgent high-priority investigations.
* Analyse internal and external malware leads.
* Identify indicators, behaviours, attack techniques and attacker objectives.

**Detection Engineering**

* Develop and validate detection logic and automated rules.
* Support improvements to malware detection capabilities.
* Work with analysts and engineering teams to improve investigative efficiency.

**Quality & Peer Review**

* Review analysis performed by other analysts.
* Validate technical findings and enforcement decisions.
* Ensure consistent technical standards and reporting quality.

**Research & Tool Development**

* Develop one-off tools, scripts and automation to support investigations.
* Contribute to internal research initiatives.
* Stay current with evolving Android threats, malware techniques and analysis methodologies.

**Experience and Expectations**

We do not require a fixed profile. Instead, we will calibrate expectations to the experience you bring.

\*\*In all cases, you will need:\*\*

* Strong programming fundamentals in at least one object-oriented language.
* A genuine interest in Android internals and how malicious software works.
* An investigative mindset – curiosity, persistence, and attention to detail.
* Clear written and spoken communication in English.

If you are an experienced analyst, we expect proven experience in one or more of: Android malware analysis, Android application security testing, mobile application reverse engineering, malware research, threat research, or mobile threat intelligence. You should be able to demonstrate skills across Java and Android internals, Smali and DEX analysis, Android application architecture, static and dynamic analysis techniques, analysis of obfuscated code, native Android libraries (C/C), and scripting or tool development (e.g. Python). In return, you will be trusted to work independently on complex cases from an early stage, lead urgent escalations, review the work of others and mentor colleagues. 

If you are earlier in your career, we do not expect the above on day one. Show us evidence that you enjoy understanding how software works and are actively developing technical security skills - CTFs, crackmes, personal reverse engineering projects, relevant coursework or published write-ups. You will receive structured training and mentoring to bring you up to the team's standard, and your responsibilities will expand as your capability does.

Candidates anywhere between these two points are equally welcome: tell us what you can already do, and we will shape both expectations and training around it.

Work is allocated according to capability and experience. All analysts receive structured mentoring, peer review and continuous technical development

**Technical Skills**

An ideal candidate will demonstrate experience with some of the following:

* Reverse engineering and static analysis – use of decompilers and disassemblers, particularly to tackle heavily obfuscated code, native libraries, and custom cryptography
* Dynamic analysis – frameworks like Frida and LSPosed particularly welcome
* Malware analysis – detection development, behavioural analysis
* Software development – Kotlin, Java, Python, C/C

**Why Join Reversec?**

Because the work here is hard, and that’s the point. We are a research-led organisation with expertise recognized across the industry, and the problems we take on rarely come with cookie-cutter answers. You’ll solve them alongside some of the strongest security specialists in the field.

We’ll invest in you too – through internal training, mentoring, and room to develop. What you build here won’t stay internal: our tooling, research, and methodologies are used throughout the security community.

**Advice for Candidates**

We expect this role to attract a significant number of applications. If you want yours to stand out, focus on helping us understand what is genuinely relevant about you.

We Read Covering Letters

We genuinely read covering letters, and they often make the difference between two otherwise similar applications.

A covering letter is your opportunity to explain:

* Why this area of security interests you.
* What relevant experience, projects, research, or personal work you've completed.
* What you've been learning recently.
* Why you believe your skills are relevant to the role.

Don't tell us what you think we want to hear. Tell us what genuinely interests you.

A candidate who can clearly explain why they enjoy reverse engineering Android applications, analysing malware, writing tooling, researching software internals, or investigating complex technical problems will stand out far more than a generic application submitted to dozens of employers.

**Tell Us What Excites You About the Subject**

We're much more interested in why you're interested in the work than why you're interested in Reversec.

We're looking for people who are excited by questions such as:

* How does this application actually work?
* What is this code trying to hide?
* Why is this behaviour occurring?
* How can this analysis be automated?
* How can software be understood more deeply?

Genuine curiosity and enthusiasm for the subject are often stronger indicators of success than a particular certification or job title.

Differentiate Yourself

Help us understand:

* What you've built.
* What you've researched.
* What you've reverse engineered.
* What you've learned outside of formal education or employment.
* What areas of Android security or malware analysis genuinely interest you.

Relevant personal projects, technical write-ups, open-source contributions, tooling, university work, challenge participation, and research are all valuable evidence of interest and capability.

**What to Expect from the Recruitment Process**

Our recruitment process is designed to help both sides determine whether this is the right fit.

Step One - CV Review

Our team will review your application to understand your background, technical skills, experience, aptitude, and overall suitability for the role.

We are not looking for a perfect checklist match. We're looking for evidence of capability, potential, curiosity, and genuine interest in the subject matter.

Step Two - Initial Interview

You'll meet with a member of our team to discuss the role, your background, and your experience.

This conversation is as much for you as it is for us. We're assessing whether the role is a good fit for your skills and aspirations, while giving you the opportunity to understand the work we do, the team you'll be joining, and whether Reversec is the right fit for you.

Step Three - Technical Challenge

Candidates who successfully complete the initial interview will be invited to complete a technical challenge.

The challenge will be representative of the type of work performed by the team and may include activities such as reverse engineering, malware analysis, software investigation, tooling development, or technical problem solving.

You'll be provided with instructions, any required files or supporting material, and a defined timeframe in which to complete the exercise. We expect candidates to work independently and document their findings as they go.

Your output should explain:

* Your approach to the problem.
* The analysis you performed.
* Any findings or conclusions you reached.
* Any limitations, assumptions, or questions that remain unanswered.

There is rarely a single "correct" answer. We are interested not only in whether you reach the right conclusion, but also in how you think, how you investigate technical problems, and how clearly you communicate your findings.

This challenge will be time bound; however we understand applicants may have work and personal commitments, and we are happy to discuss reasonable adjustments where required.

Completed challenges should be returned to the hiring manager within the specified timeframe.

Step Four - Technical Interview

You'll meet with members of the technical team for a deeper discussion around your technical background, problem-solving approach, and relevant experience.

The goal is not to catch you out or test obscure facts. We want to understand how you think, how you approach technical challenges, and how your skills align with the work we perform.

For experienced candidates, this may involve detailed discussions around reverse engineering, malware analysis, security research, development, or tooling. For less experienced candidates, we're often just as interested in your reasoning, curiosity, and willingness to learn.

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a detail-focused approach
* Confident, proactive and self-motivated, able to work independently and within teams
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively in written, verbal, and customer-facing settings
* Experience working in fast-paced, matrix organisations and managing competing priorities
* Ability to prepare and present design concepts and technical proposals to stakeholders and customers
* Able to handle confidential information appropriately
* Willingness to take ownership and deliver against business goals and objectives

**Desirable Competencies and Experience**

* Understanding of other engineering functions, including analysis, simulation, hydraulics, development, test, assembly, and control systems
* Exposure to or interest in powertrain electrification
* Awareness of intellectual property (IP), including experience with patent searching and review
* Experience using 3D CAD systems such as CATIA V5/V6, Creo, or NX

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person's potential, and we'll help you reach yours. We have an ambitious diversity, equality, and inclusion approach as explained here. ## Description

Would you like to be part of the Ryanair Group’s amazing cabin crew family of 16k+ crew? If you are customer-oriented, love delivering great service & want fast-track career opportunities, we would be delighted to hear from you! No experience is required, just bags of enthusiasm & team spirit!

Cabin Crew International, recruitment partner of Ryanair Group are currently recruiting for Cabin Crew in Manchester. They will be holding a Recruitment Day in Manchester, apply now!

**Location: Manchester**

**Date:  7th September 2026**

**You will be invited to attend once your application has been reviewed.**

As Europe’s largest airline group carrying over 600K guests on over 3,600 daily flights. Flying on board Ryanair Group aircraft there are some amazing perks, including; discounted staff travel to over 250+ destinations across the Ryanair network, a fixed roster pattern, free training & industry-leading pay.

Your journey to becoming a qualified cabin crew member will start on a 6-week training course where you will learn all of the fundamental skills that you will require as part of your day-to-day role delivering a top-class safety & customer service experience to our guests. During the course you will be required to study with exams taking place at regular intervals, the training culminates with Supernumerary flights, followed by your Cabin Crew Wings.

As a member of the Ryanair Group cabin crew family, you will be immersed into our culture from day one, the career opportunities are endless including becoming a number 1, base supervisor, Regional Manager or why not aspire to becoming our Director of Inflight?

Life as Cabin Crew is fun & rewarding, it is however a demanding position where safety is our number 1 priority. You will be required to operate both early & late shifts & report for duty as early as 5 am in the morning on the early roster & not return home until midnight on the afternoon roster. If you are not a morning person, then think twice before applying!

## Some of our amazing benefits;

* Daily per Diem whilst training – £28 per day
* Free Internationally recognised Cabin Crew Training Course
* Uncapped Sales bonus
* New Joiners Bonus of £1200
* Unlimited highly discounted Staff Travel
* Fixed roster pattern
* The adventure and experience of a lifetime within our Cabin Crew network
* Explore new cultures and cities with colleagues on your days off
* Free Uniform in Year 1 and annual allowance afterwards
* Security of working for a financially stable Airline

## Requirements

* Applicants must hold the unrestricted right to live and work in the UK and travel freely throughout the Ryanair Network
* You must approximately be between 5 “2 (157 cm) and 6” 2 (188 cm) in height.
* You must be able to swim 25 meters unaided.
* It helps if you are hardworking, flexible and have an outgoing and friendly personality.
* Adaptable and happy to work a shift roster.
* Enjoy dealing with the public and have the ability to provide excellent customer service with a ‘can do’ attitude.
* Comfortable speaking and writing in English with ease.
* A passion for travelling and meeting new people.

Application

**Ryanair is looking for a highly skilled and experienced airline professional to work in a highly varied and dynamic environment within engineering. S&P Dow Jones Indices is seeking an Equities & Digital Assets R&D Analyst within the Index Design team to support the research, design, analysis and delivery of differentiated index solutions within the Equities & Digital Assets value stream. Reporting to an R&D Team Manager, with oversight from the Head of Equities & Digital Assets Index Design, the role will help translate product and client needs into systematic, scalable and well-documented index concepts.

On-Water Operations - Southampton

SailGP Technologies is the high performance design, engineering and manufacturing arm of SailGP, the global purpose-led sail grand prix championship.

The Rolex SailGP Championship is the most exciting racing on water, where anything can happen in short, adrenaline-fueled battles between national teams at iconic stadium destinations worldwide. The Chase Boat Mechanic is responsible for the maintenance, servicing, repair and operational readiness of the SailGP chase boat fleet. Working within the On Water Operations (OWO) team, this role ensures all chase boats remain safe, reliable and event-ready throughout the race season. The position requires an experienced marine mechanic who is comfortable working in fast-paced, mixed environments including workshops, marinas, shipyards and international event venues.

**GENERAL MANAGER -** LITTLE BAO BOY BRAND  
**DEPARTMENT: OFFICE OF THE CEO**  
**💷 £70-80k Base + Up to 50% Bonus + Shares  
🚆HYBRID - London Based (Victoria Station) & Remote 1 or 2 days per week with some travel based duties.**  
  
**WHO ARE WE?**  
***#14 - Fastest Growing UK Tech Company*** *(Sunday Times)* ***#65 - Fastest Growing UK&I Company*** *(Sifted)****#77 - Fastest Growing Europe Company*** *(Sifted)*

Sessions is building the operating model for the future of restaurants, giving consumers instant access to the brands they love, wherever they live.

The Sessions distribution engine runs through 400+ delivery kitchens and 16 high street restaurants across the UK.

Founded in 2020 and led by ex-Deliveroo MD Dan Warne, Sessions has grown 7x in three years. Our platform has processed over 5 million orders and reaches 60% of the UK population. Our team brings experience from Deliveroo, Amazon, BrewDog, and Gousto.

We scale brands at a pace that redefines what's possible in food. Examples include Miko's Gyros, which went from launch to 100+ live sites in under two months and SoBe Burger, which is live in over 200 delivery locations and has opened 15 physical high street stores.

**🏃‍♀️ We are Agile -** Thrive in fast-pace. We sprint, adapt, and learn.  
**🌍 We are Ambitious -** Contribute to something big. Watch your career grow bigger.  
**🤪 We are Fun -**High performance, high fives. Join a team you'll love.  
**🤖We are Data-Driven -** Turn insights into action. We lead with evidence.  
💡**We have Initiative -**Anticipate problems. Drive the solution.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

As the **General Manager for your assigned Brand(s)**, you will operate with a "mini-CEO" mindset, taking full ownership of our high-potential brands like Mikos and Little Bao Boy. This is an intensely commercial and entrepreneurial role where you define the brand's trajectory and are ultimately accountable for its success within the Sessions ecosystem.

This is a truly cross-functional mission. You will own everything from high-level marketing strategy and FMCG expansion opportunities to granular decisions on property estate quality and strategic site selection. While you lead through collaboration - influencing Growth, Ops, and Culinary teams - you carry the ultimate responsibility for the brand's P&L and market position. You are not just a manager; you are the driving force behind the brand's commercial soul.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

###### **1. Strategic & Operational Brand Ownership**

You have hands-on accountability for the elements that define and drive brand demand:

* **Positioning & Brand Equity**: Define the target customer, core proposition, price positioning, and "occasion fit." Refine the brand positioning continuously and ensure it is reflected consistently across physical QSR sites, FMCG, and digital channels.
* **Off-Platform Brand Building:** Build awareness and "soul" beyond the delivery apps. Oversee the brand’s social media presence, maintain a regular cadence of content, and lead local activation campaigns to drive local demand.
* **Brand Partnerships:** Identify, build, and execute high-impact collaborations with influencers, Studio teams, and complementary brands—turning an underutilized area into a major growth driver.
* **Visual Identity & Tone of Voice:** Ensure the brand shows up consistently and distinctively across all touchpoints, including physical QSR (Quick Service Restaurant) locations.
* **Demand Generation**: Shape major campaigns (e.g., Seasonal Specials, limited-time offers) and lead high-level demand planning in partnership with the Growth team.

###### 2. Commercial & Business Development

* **Obsessive Network Expansion:** Drive expansion by relentlessly pushing the Sales team to sign more sites and the Ops team to add the brand wherever it isn't present. When needed, pick up the phone yourself to make expansion happen.
* **QSR Model Proof & Rollout**: Personally launch the first QSR sites—find franchisees, secure property, and prove the model. Once predictable, hand it over to the QSR team to scale.
* **Founder & Strategic Relationships**: Own the founder relationship and help shape the FMCG strategy so it develops in lockstep with Sessions’ wider approach. Manage tracking toward call options where applicable.
* **Investments & Long-Term Exit Strategy:** Assess external investment opportunities into the brand and evaluate long-term exit options to allow capital recycling into future brand development.

###### 3. Accountability & Growth

* **Brand P&L Ownership**: Take full accountability for driving GMV, Order Volume, Average Order Value (AOV), and Contribution Margin in close coordination with the Operations team.
* **Pricing & Promotions**: Work closely with the Growth team to set high-level pricing and promotional strategies that drive volume while protecting long-term brand equity.

###### 4. Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence

* **Creative & Merchandising**: Partner with Creative/Studio resources to ensure in-app merchandising (imagery, menu layout, copy) reflects brand strategy and maximizes conversion.
* **Sales & Operations Alignment:** Partner with and "apply healthy pressure" to Sales, QSR, and Ops teams to define growth areas, prioritize new site expansion, and enforce consistency via playbooks.
* **Culinary & Supply Chain**: Influence menu development and ingredient choices to ensure the product is both "on-brand" and commercially scalable.

***Disclaimer:*** *This job description provides a summary of the main duties and responsibilities. It is not an exhaustive list, and the successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate flexibility and take on reasonable duties and projects not explicitly mentioned here as the needs of the business evolve.*

**DESIRED SKILLS, EXPERIENCE & QUALITIES:**

We are looking for a commercial heavyweight who possesses a rare blend of creative brand-building and analytical rigour.

* **The "FMCG Playbook":** Experience in a sophisticated brand management environment (e.g., FMCG or retail) is highly desirable.
* **Commercial Gravitas:** You are comfortable owning a P&L and can speak the language of margins and data just as well as the language of design and "vibe."
* **Master of Influence:** You can navigate internal friction and align different departments (who have their own KPIs) toward your brand’s North Star.
* **Entrepreneurial Grit:** You are a "founder-minded" leader who can build a brand from the ground up without needing a massive marketing agency at your beck and call.
* Charismatic and energetic with a passion for food
* Expert level of English language
* Right to work in the UK

**BENEFITS & PERKS**

***Share Options*** - Receive an amount of share options for Sessions Market Ltd.  
***Pay day on demand -*** Access to pay whenever needed  
***Expense card -*** Company Card

***Holidays -*** 25 days + bank holidays + Birthday Off  
***Healthcare -*** Healthcare Cash Plan scheme

The 1st Team Lead Physical Performance Coach will lead the Physical Performance programme for the Women's First Team, overseeing physical performance delivery, profiling, testing, load monitoring, injury prevention and on-pitch rehabilitation support.

As a senior member of the multidisciplinary team, they will drive the ongoing development of the Club's physical performance provision, ensuring all programmes are aligned to the demands of elite women's football and maximise player performance and availability.

They will be motivated by the Club's footballing strategy of Out Run, Out Fight, Out Play, ensuring all physical performance strategies support the Club's Football Philosophy.

**Core Role Responsibilities:**

**Physical Performance Delivery**

* Design and deliver gym- and pitch-based physical sessions, working collaboratively with the wider MDT to ensure complementary and non-overlapping programming.
* Lead the planning and periodisation of physical preparation across pre-season, in-season, and transition phases, aligned to the coaching schedule and football demands.
* Design and deliver individualised physical development programmes for first-team players that enhance their ability to repeatedly perform high-intensity and explosive actions throughout matches and sustain physical performance across a competitive season.
* Lead on matchday preparation, activation, and post-match recovery protocols.
* Ensure physical programmes are aligned to the Club's football philosophy, the demands of elite women's football, and current evidence relating to female athlete development, physiology, injury risk factors and performance optimisation.
* Continually review, challenge and evolve physical performance practices through the application of emerging research, technology and evidence-informed methodologies.

**Profiling, Testing and Load Monitoring**

* Lead pre-season and in-season physical testing cycles and maintain up-to-date individual player physical profiles.
* Oversee external and internal load monitoring using GPS, heart rate, RPE, and wellness tools, ensuring data is collected consistently and actioned in a timely manner.
* Produce clear, accessible reports and summaries that inform coaching and medical staff decisions - familiarity with data visualisation tools is expected.
* Monitor training responses, flag risk, and adapt programmes based on player data and medical input.
* Utilise physical performance data to inform individual player development, identify performance opportunities and support evidence-based decision-making across the multidisciplinary team.
* Maintain accurate documentation of physical assessments, load data, and player progress within the club's athlete management system.

**Injury Prevention and Rehabilitation Support**  
In collaboration with the medical department:

* Lead the design and implementation of injury prevention, prehabilitation, movement preparation and activation strategies that enhance athlete robustness and maximise player availability.
* Contribute to return-to-train and return-to-play pathways, supporting criteria-based progression and physical re-integration.
* Analyse injury trends and physical performance data to inform long-term robustness programmes and proactive injury risk reduction strategies across the squad.
* Develop and oversee Individual Development Plans (IDPs), implementing targeted interventions to support physical development, movement quality and injury risk reduction.
* Liaise regularly with physiotherapy and sports medicine staff to ensure a coordinated approach to player management.

**Multidisciplinary Collaboration**

* Operate as a senior member of the first team MDT, building effective working relationships across coaching, medical, analysis and nutrition functions.
* Act as the primary physical performance point of contact within the first team, contributing to performance reviews, planning meetings, and player management discussions.
* Represent the department's physical performance provision to coaching staff and club leadership with clarity and confidence.
* Communicate player status, physical readiness, and training loads to the 1st Team Head Coach on an ongoing basis.

**Academy Pathway Oversight**

* Maintain a collaborative relationship with the Women's Academy physical performance staff to support coherent player transitions and consistency of physical development philosophy.
* Support the development of a club-wide physical performance framework that promotes consistency in athlete development principles and physical performance standards across the women's and girls' pathway.
* Act as a point of reference for the Academy on first team physical standards and expectations.

## Overview

Role

StarCompliance is seeking a Lead Design Engineer – AI Product Experience who will shape how user experiences are designed, prototyped, and delivered across our engineering organisation. This role is responsible for bringing together user experience design, frontend engineering, and AI-assisted development to create scalable product experience standards that can be consistently applied by both engineers and AI agents.

This is not a traditional UX design or UI engineering role. The successful candidate will operate as a highly technical, hands-on design engineering leader focused on evolving our design system for agentic consumption, creating working prototypes in place of static design handovers, and ensuring that accessibility, usability, and consistency are embedded directly into our frontend foundations.

The role will work closely with Software Engineering, Product, Architecture, Platform Engineering, and AI Enablement teams to establish reusable components, interaction patterns, agent instructions, and governance that support faster, more consistent, and increasingly autonomous product delivery.

How We Think About AI

At StarCompliance, AI is not a side experiment or an isolated specialist capability. We treat it as a foundational part of modern software engineering and SaaS platform development.

We expect engineers to:

* Actively use AI-assisted engineering tools as part of their daily workflows.

* Apply AI to improve design quality, development velocity, automation depth, operational insight, and overall engineering effectiveness.

* Ensure AI-generated outputs are validated, auditable, and compliant with security, privacy, and regulatory standards.

### Key Responsibilities

**Design System & Frontend Foundations**

+ Own the strategy, architecture, and ongoing evolution of StarCompliance’s enterprise design system, ensuring it supports consistent delivery across products and teams.

+ Develop the design system into an AI-consumable platform that can be reliably used by engineers, coding assistants, and autonomous development agents.

+ Define reusable components, design tokens, interaction patterns, application layouts, and accessibility standards.

+ Create clear documentation, examples, constraints, and validation mechanisms that enable reliable agent-generated user interfaces.

+ Maintain alignment between the design system, shared frontend foundations, and StarCompliance’s wider technical architecture.

**Design Engineering & Prototyping**

+ Translate product opportunities, user needs, and business requirements into working prototypes rather than relying on static design handovers.

+ Use code and AI-assisted development tools to create realistic product experiences that can be tested and refined with users.

+ Work with Product, customers, subject matter experts, and engineers to explore workflows, validate solutions, and improve concepts before production delivery.

+ Define interaction models for complex compliance workflows, data-intensive applications, and AI-enabled product capabilities.

**Agentic Product Development**

+ Define how AI agents should interpret product intent and generate user interfaces using approved components and experience standards.

+ Create and maintain agent instructions, reference implementations, rules, and machine-readable context for frontend development.

+ Partner with AI Enablement and Engineering teams to embed design system knowledge into agentic development workflows.

+ Establish governance for agent-generated interfaces, including accessibility validation, visual regression testing, and component conformance.

+ Review agent outputs and improve the components, guidance, and context required to produce reliable results.

**Product Experience & Accessibility**

+ Ensure user-centred design principles remain embedded within an increasingly automated software development process.

+ Champion accessible and inclusive design, ensuring accessibility requirements are built into components, patterns, and automated validation.

+ Use customer feedback, product analytics, usability evaluation, and telemetry to improve product experiences.

+ Ensure delivery speed does not come at the expense of usability, consistency, maintainability, or user trust.

**Technical Leadership & Governance**

+ Lead the Design System Forum, bringing together Product, Engineering, and Architecture to govern shared standards and prioritise the continued evolution of the design system.

+ Lead and develop a blended team of UI Engineers across permanent and consultancy partner resources, with responsibility for performance, workload allocation, delivery, and capability development.

+ Act as StarCompliance’s technical authority for design engineering and frontend experience, providing hands-on guidance and representing the discipline within relevant governance forums.

+ Coach Product Managers and engineers in prototype-led discovery, AI-assisted development, and the effective use of shared frontend foundations.

### Skills and Experience

+ Strong background in design engineering, frontend engineering, or user experience design.

+ Hands-on experience building modern React and TypeScript applications.

+ Experience creating or governing enterprise design systems, including component architecture, design tokens, and interaction patterns.

+ Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools and supporting agentic software delivery workflows.

+ Strong understanding of accessibility, inclusive design, and working prototype development.

+ Strong stakeholder communication, technical leadership, and people management capability.

### Desirable Skills

+ Experience within SaaS, enterprise, or regulated software environments.

+ Knowledge of Storybook, visual regression testing, automated accessibility testing, and frontend quality tooling.

+ Experience managing permanent employees and consultancy partner resources.

+ Familiarity with product analytics, usability testing, and behavioural telemetry.

To be eligible for employment with StarCompliance, candidates must undergo a rigorous background investigation with checks including, but not limited to, criminal record history, consumer credit, employment history, qualifications, and education checks.

# Financial Payroll Analyst

**Location –** Glasgow

**Salary –** £40,000-43,000

**Contract –** Permanent

Are you an analytical problem-solver who enjoys turning payroll data into meaningful financial insights?

At Stena Line, payroll is about much more than processing salaries. It's about ensuring our people are supported, our financial records are accurate, and our business can make informed decisions. We are now looking for a Payroll Finance Analyst to join our Payroll & Benefits team and play a key role in connecting payroll and finance operations across the business.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining technical accounting knowledge with analytical thinking and continuous improvement. If you thrive on accuracy, collaboration and turning data into meaningful insights, this could be the role for you.

**What makes the job so great?**

As a Payroll Finance Analyst, you will be at the heart of payroll and finance operations, ensuring employment-related costs are reported accurately and allocated correctly across the business. You'll work closely with colleagues in Payroll, Finance, Reward and wider business functions, giving you exposure to a broad range of stakeholders and processes.

You'll have the opportunity to influence improvements, support business-critical reporting, contribute to projects and help drive the digital development of the Payroll & Benefits function. Every month brings new challenges, opportunities to analyse trends and the satisfaction of delivering accurate financial information that supports business decisions.

**Some of your key responsibilities**

* Ensure accurate accounting and allocation of payroll-related costs within finance systems
* Reconcile payroll-related balance sheet and profit and loss accounts in line with agreed timetables and standards
* Act as the key finance contact within the Payroll & Benefits team and the primary payroll contact for Finance stakeholders
* Analyse payroll cost movements and provide meaningful commentary on monthly variances
* Support year-end activities, including holiday pay accrual calculations and employment cost reporting
* Manage company car administration within the UK
* Safeguard the correct administration of VAT within the expense management system
* Support Group Payroll and Group Reward with employee data, statistics, governance activities and reporting requirements
* Participate in projects and continuous improvement initiatives within your area of expertise

**What you will experience**

You will become part of a collaborative and supportive Payroll & Benefits team where knowledge sharing, continuous learning and teamwork are highly valued. We work closely with colleagues across Finance, HR and operational departments, creating a varied and engaging working environment.

At Stena Line, we believe that great results come from great people working together. You'll find a welcoming atmosphere where colleagues support one another, celebrate successes and continuously look for ways to improve. Through team activities, well-being initiatives and opportunities to contribute to exciting business projects, you'll be encouraged to grow both professionally and personally.

**Benefits**

As a Stena Line employee, you'll enjoy a competitive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, development and work-life balance. This includes:

* Concessionary travel on Irish Sea and North Sea routes
* 75% discount on UK rail travel
* Company pension and life assurance
* Gym and wellbeing discounts
* Wellbeing cash plan
* Enhanced parental leave
* Cycle-to-work scheme
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Ongoing training and development opportunities

We believe a hybrid solution between working in the office and working remotely will create the best environment for us to be creative, productive and find a work-life balance creating magic today and tomorrow.

**Who you are**

At Stena Line your personality matters as much as how good you are at what you do. Regardless of your role, our behaviours welcoming, caring and reliable guide you in your everyday work and the challenges you face.

We believe you are a naturally analytical person who enjoys working with figures and finding solutions to complex problems. You have a structured and detail-oriented approach and take pride in delivering accurate work, even when working to tight deadlines. You are collaborative and enjoy building positive relationships with colleagues across different functions. At the same time, you are curious and continuously look for opportunities to improve processes and ways of working. Most importantly, you understand the value of accuracy, accountability and excellent customer service when supporting both employees and business stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience
* Experience working with employment cost accounting, payroll accounting or a similar finance-related role
* Good understanding of accounting principles and month-end reconciliation processes
* Experience analysing financial data and producing meaningful reports and commentary
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial and/or payroll systems
* Ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across Payroll, Finance and HR functions
* Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal

**Information about the recruitment process**

In order to ensure fair and unbiased selection, we do not request a personal letter. Instead, we request your responses to our selection questions. If you proceed, you will then receive an email with a link to our recruitment assessments, objectively identifying the most suitable candidate for the role.

# Connections and Commissioning Project Manager

We have an exciting opportunity for a Connections and Commissioning Project Manager to join our growing HARP project team. This is the perfect time to become a part of the largest critical infrastructure project in the UK.

#### What matters to us

* Relevant experience gained on clean water infrastructure projects, ideally including connections and commissioning works delivered directly with a water company or other asset owner.
* First-hand experience of the connection and integration process with an asset owner - understanding how their standards, review boards and sign-off processes shape delivery, and how to work within them.
* Practical knowledge of water quality requirements - hygiene standards, disinfection and testing regimes for potable water assets - and what it takes to pass water quality testing first time.
* Experience in setting up sites in a way that protects quality and gives certainty of outcome - compound layout, hygiene control, access and working-area planning.
* A meticulous, detail-driven approach to upfront planning, with experience developing plans and sequences robust enough to remove ambiguity before construction starts.
* Experience integrating multiple supply chain/delivery partners - civils, MEICA, cleaning and specialist subcontractors - into a single, coherent delivery plan.
* Experience embedding commissioning and buildability requirements into design development, working closely with engineering and design teams.
* Comfortable owning delivery and commercial outcomes on high-value, high-risk scopes with compensation-bearing or liquidated-damages exposure.

STRABAG - More than just a construction company

#### Your contribution to our company

**Upfront planning and design development**

* Lead meticulous, detailed upfront planning for every connections and commissioning site — removing ambiguity well before construction starts, so that outage windows, sequencing and resourcing are certain rather than assumed.
* Sit within the design review cycle for every Water Infrastructure package, supporting design development so that constructability, connection and cleaning requirements are built in rather than resolved after the design is frozen for construction.
* Work with the Engineering Manager and early contractor involvement (ECI) partners to validate siphon connection buildability ahead of each Issue for Construction (IFC) package.
* Ensure the chosen cleaning and commissioning methodologies and associated access/space requirements inform design geometry.

**Supply chain integration and delivery**

* Lead the integration of key supply chain partners into a single, coherent delivery plan — self-delivered reinforced concrete works, MLS and MEICA delivery partners, specialist cleaning contractors where required, and commissioning support if needed.
* Engage supply chain partners early to secure experienced and competent resources, plant and capability against known market constraints, protecting programme certainty.
* Own the connections and commissioning delivery sequence for every site, from pre-outage investigation and detailed design through early connection works to construction completion and Operational Readiness.
* Develop the detailed Commissioning Plan by working backwards from each site's Ready-for-Outage date, with activities planned down to two- and four-hour blocks to maximise productivity within restricted outage windows. Engineering manager, planner, and supply chain support. 
* Manage the operational constraints that govern every connection: only one MLS line offline at a time, no more than two siphons exposed concurrently, minimum gaps between partial outages, and the correct connection order across siphon lines.

**Site set-up, quality and certainty of outcome**

* Set up every site — compounds, working areas, hygiene controls and access arrangements — in a way that protects quality and gives certainty of outcome from day one, drawing on direct experience of what good looks like on a clean water project.
* Ensure every connection and commissioning activity is delivered within the controls set by the Build Clean Strategy and the Water Quality Assurance Management Plan (WQAMP).
* Own the cleaning and disinfection regime for new pipework and Water Infrastructure — flushing, chlorination, standing time, sampling and testing — in line with contractual requirements and UU's stringent water hygiene standards.
* Track the multiple clocks that apply once a sample is taken (entry into service, return of the asset to UU control, and post-connection water quality monitoring) so no statutory or contractual window is missed.

**Integration with the asset owner**

* Act as a key point of connection and integration with United Utilities as the asset owner, building the working relationship needed to align design, planning and delivery decisions with their expectations and standards.
* Lead STRABAG's engagement with the Water Quality Risk Board (WQRB) through its review cadence in the run-up to each outage, and coordinate closely with the SUK Water Quality Assurance Manager.
* Engage the wider United Utilities/CAP stakeholder group as required, including the Asset Supportability Engineer and the Aqueduct/Operational and Networks teams.

**Testing and commissioning**

* Direct the testing and commissioning programme for each asset: pressure testing, disinfection, water quality monitoring, water into supply, and the monitoring period that follows.
* Ensure Inspection & Test Plans are complete and that hold points are respected before material production, dispatch and release for cleaning.
* Own contingency planning for test or sample failure, including timely submission of remedial proposals to the client where required.

**Commercial and risk management**

* Own the successful commercial and delivery outcome of one of the highest-risk scopes on the project — protecting STRABAG UK from the substantial compensation and delay-damage exposure attached to connections and commissioning.
* Track every contractual submission deadline and ensure packages are ready in good time, avoiding avoidable compensation events.
* Maintain and report the commissioning and handover document register, giving leadership clear visibility of what is complete, in progress, or still open.
* Contribute to commercial strategy discussions and the evaluation and selection of delivery partners and key subcontractors for the connections and commissioning scope.

**Regulatory engagement, leadership and HSQE**

* Support with, and manage as needed, engagement with the regulatory and statutory bodies relevant to the scope — including the Drinking Water Inspectorate, the Environment Agency, HSE and other relevant authorities — as connection and commissioning activities require.
* Support customer and community communications during connection and outage works.
* Provide clear day-to-day leadership across the connections and commissioning effort, working in close partnership with the Connections and Commissioning Lead, Engineering Manager, Commercial team and Compound Representatives.
* Ensure structured training and competence — site-specific hygiene training and broader training needs analysis — is delivered to everyone involved in cleaning, disinfection, testing and commissioning.
* Champion health, safety and quality standards across all connections and commissioning activity.

**Pre-employment screening** is required for this position. More information on our career website.

The Creative Studio Traffic Manager is the day-to-day engine that keeps creative work moving through the studio with clarity, pace and discipline.

Where the Creative Studio Manager owns the broader operating model, capacity planning and studio performance, the Creative Studio Traffic Manager brings that model to life every day by coordinating the movement of projects, people and information across creative, client services, production and delivery teams.

Produce comprehensive evaluation reports based on professional expertise and robust analysis, providing clear feedback to training sponsors and stakeholders to assess whether intended learning outcomes and organisational objectives have been achieved.

Research and evaluate contemporary learning theories, methodologies, and technologies in collaboration with Learning and Professional Development colleagues, ensuring training provision remains effective, evidence-based, and aligned to organisational and strategic priorities set by Chief Officers and Police and Crime Commissioners.

Apply sound decision-making skills, utilising the National Decision Model (NDM) and Threat, Harm and Risk principles to effectively balance competing priorities and manage resources, including staffing, finances, facilities, and operational demands. Monitor and evaluate a representative sample of Use of Force forms each month to ensure compliance, identify trends, and provide constructive feedback to support organisational learning and continuous improvement.

Review referrals and submissions from Professional Standards Departments (PSD) relating to potential Use of Force misconduct matters, providing specialist advice and expert opinion in support of both internal and external investigations.

Proven experience of leading, managing, and developing teams comprising of individuals with a diverse range of skills, knowledge, and experience.

Recent experience within a policing training environment or frontline policing role, with a sound understanding of operational policing requirements.

Comprehensive knowledge of a variety of training delivery methods, including the effective use of innovative and emerging learning technologies.

Demonstrated ability to effectively delegate responsibilities, ensuring resources are utilised efficiently whilst maintaining accountability and quality standards.

Highly developed problem-solving skills, with the ability to work autonomously or collaboratively with colleagues and managers to identify, develop, and implement strategic solutions.

Consistently adopts a customer-focused approach, ensuring that service delivery meets the needs and expectations of stakeholders and end users.

Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with stakeholders at all levels.

Proven ability to plan, coordinate, and lead complex projects involving multiple contributors across departments and Force areas, ensuring objectives are delivered within agreed timescales.

Self-motivated, proactive, and highly organised, with the flexibility to respond effectively to changing priorities and challenging deadlines.

Confident in representing the Learning and Development function at strategic meetings, providing professional advice, updates, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Demonstrates resilience, professionalism, and sound judgement when operating in high-pressure environments and managing competing demands.

Ability to complete the JRFT to maintain level 5.4 on a yearly basis along with CPD reaccreditation as mandated by the College of Policing.

Strong report-writing skills, with the ability to produce concise, accurate, and evidence-based reports, often within tight timescales and for internal and external stakeholders, including HMICFRS.

## The Role and Key Responsibilities

Contact Centre Officers serve as a vital front-line point of contact between the public and the police, responding to reports of incidents and crime from across Surrey.

The force’s mission is for people to be safe and feel safe. One moment you may be dealing with a victim of a burglary, the next you could be recording intelligence being offered by the community about a drug dealer, before then taking a call about a serious road traffic accident.

This role requires strong communication and inter-personal skills to handle a wide range of calls, including emergency and non-emergency situations, with professionalism and composure.

The Contact Centre Officer role demands a combination of interpersonal, technical, and organisational skills. Contact Handlers play a critical role in providing essential services during emergencies and require the ability to remain calm, empathetic, and methodical in challenging situations. The ideal candidate should be adaptable, a strong communicator, and committed to maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and service.

**Effective Communication**

The ability to communicate clearly and empathetically is essential, especially when delivering difficult messages or dealing with individuals in distress. Contact Handlers must convey information effectively and confidently, including managing expectations, and remain calm under pressure when handling emotionally charged interactions.

**Resilience**

The role is extremely rewarding but also comes with some challenges. For example, during your shift you will be taking calls from members of the public who are distressed, angry, abusive and emotional or experiencing a mental health crisis – probably contacting Surrey Police for the very first time in their hour of need. We ask you to think carefully about how this might impact on your well being and especially how you will cope in and following these types of calls.

There is plenty of support available but if you, your family or people you are close to have ever experienced suicide, domestic and sexual abuse, fear for loss of life or trauma (especially regarding children) – please do seriously consider how this will impact on you.

**Empathy**

Good people skills are essential. Demonstrating appropriate levels of empathy and understanding towards callers is crucial. Contact Handlers should provide reassurance and support even when immediate assistance cannot be dispatched.

**Initiative**

The ideal candidate should be organised, independent, and able to multi-task and work with minimal supervision when required. They must be able to work and make good decisions under pressure. The role involves reading between the lines, understanding tone and emotions to recognise when someone is not okay even if they say they are, and asking the right questions to gather as much information as possible.

**IT Competency**

Typing skills, including the ability to type at a minimum of 30 words-per-minute, and navigate computer systems efficiently, are crucial. Information must be recorded accurately. It is essential that candidates are conversant with Microsoft Windows 11, including use of the Microsoft Office suite of packages. Being able to adapt to, and learn, new IT systems is also key as the job involves using multiple unique software systems. With the training given, recruits are empowered to risk assess and prioritise each incident, ensuring an appropriate response.

**Flexibility**

If shift work is new to you, please take some time to thoroughly research the challenge this presents to all shift workers and the effect this can have on relationships, health and domestic arrangements. Think about talking the practicalities and realities of shift work through with those closest to you.

While not considered critical, having a background in customer service or people-facing roles, and experience talking on the phone are qualities beneficial for the position. The ideal candidate should be able to work with people from all walks of life and have the ability to engage in conversations politely and effectively.

Being able to relate to those from different backgrounds and communities is an essential part of the role. We support victims in bringing offenders of crime to justice and work to protect some of the most vulnerable within society. This requires an open mind to be able to see things from their unique perspective, adapting communication styles, and dealing with some very sensitive and often distressing situations.

Education: There are no essential requirements, but it is desirable that candidates are educated to QCF Level 2 in English and Maths. It's also desirable, but not essential, that applicants have a typing or keyboard qualification (RSA or equivalent) or an IT qualification such as ITQ/ECDL/CLAIT.

The **Arrears Team Leader (Outbound)** will be responsible for supporting the Operations Director in leading a team of up to 10 Arrears Executives across the full arrears lifecycle for the Bank's unsecured, motor and mortgage portfolios. The team is responsible for proactively engaging with customers experiencing financial difficulty or arrears, from early-stage arrears through to late-stage collections activity, helping customers understand their available options and reach sustainable repayment solutions.

The team operates as an outbound collections function, completing high volumes of customer contact through both automated dialler technology and manual outbound calling activity. In addition to telephony activity, the team is responsible for a range of arrears-related administration tasks, including the set up and maintenance of repayment arrangements and liaising liaison with Debt Management Companies (DMCs).

Our aim is to provide exceptional service to customers experiencing financial difficulty while ensuring fair customer outcomes, successful collections performance and adherence to all regulatory requirements.

**Your Impact: Building a sustainable tomorrow**

As an Arrears Team Leader at Tandem your focus will be on:

* Lead and motivate a team of Arrears Executives responsible for managing customer accounts across the full arrears lifecycle.
* Manage the day-to-day performance of an outbound collections team, ensuring dialler and manual call activity is completed effectively and customer outcomes remain at the heart of every interaction.
* Successfully coordinate outbound collections strategies and campaigns across all arrears populations.
* Ensure arrears-related administration activities are completed accurately and within agreed service levels, including repayment arrangements, direct debit amendments, customer correspondence, DMP administration, insolvency notifications and third-party requests.
* Ensure team members robustly explore the causes of financial difficulty and identify appropriate, sustainable and customer-focused forbearance solutions.
* Work collaboratively with the Specialist Support Team (SST), Recoveries, Operations Administration, Legal and third-party debt advice organisations to support customers appropriately.
* Maintain oversight of vulnerable customer interactions and ensure colleagues identify, record and respond appropriately to vulnerability indicators.
* Support the planning and management of dialler strategies, resource allocation and operational capacity to maximise collections effectiveness and customer engagement.
* Continuously review and refine operational processes, dialler strategies, customer journeys and ways of working to improve performance and customer outcomes.
* Self-identify operational risks and support with the creation and completion of associated first line controls and instil a culture of risk identification within the team.
* Self-identify and own operational risk events, robustly documenting these in our risk management system. Also support any customer remediation that may be required due to the risk event
* Ambassador for our BEST values, ensuring that our customers are at the heart of Operations
* Provide leadership motivation and support to your team including completing monthly 121’s and coaching and support on an ongoing basis for each colleague
* Providing career progression support when requested by a colleague in your team
* Support workforce planning, dialler resource management and capacity forecasting to ensure sufficient coverage across all arrears activities.
* Adhere to FCA guidelines ensuring that all work is compliant and aligned to regulatory standards
* Responsible for supporting the Training & Competence Manager with training for new and existing Arrears Executives and ongoing leadership oversight to ensure adherence to the group Training & Competency Policy
* Support the Operations leadership team with relevant management information to demonstrate the support delivered to our customers in financial difficulty /arrears (for both internal and external use with our Regulator and third parties)
* Provide support to the wider Operations teams when required

**We’d love to hear from you if you have:**

* Demonstrable experience leading outbound collections, arrears or financial support teams within a regulated financial services environment.
* Demonstrable knowledge of FCA rules relating to unsecured loans, hire purchase agreements and mortgages (including CONC 7 and MCOB 13)
* Experience managing outbound dialler operations and performance metrics.

* Strong understanding of collections strategies across the full arrears lifecycle.
* Personally driven to enhance team and individual performance
* Demonstrable communication skills including ability to provide clear, constructive feedback to direct reports alongside experience in effective coaching and training

* Collaborating with our technical team to define and scope small changes and configurations, translating business needs into clear, well-structured briefs that developers can act on.

* Working autonomously on projects, managing your own time and priorities whilst staying aligned with your Project Manager and broader delivery team.

**What you need to succeed**

**Essential**

* Strong, proven knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE/CRM: you understand the platform deeply and can configure it confidently without needing a developer's help for routine customisation.
* Excellent consultancy and communication skills: lead workshops with confidence, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn: you proactively seek out answers, ask considered questions and validate your understanding rather than making assumptions.

**About us**

Salford City Council's Strengthening Families program is an award winning innovative , intensive, long-term early help service for:

* vulnerable first time parents who are at risk of having their first child removed through court proceedings
* or have had at least one child removed from their care through court proceedings and present as pregnant again .

The program aims to increase the number of parents and babies who can stay together and reduce recurrent care proceedings

**About the Role**

The Strengthening Families Practitioner plays a vital role in supporting vulnerable families across Salford and beyond. Practitioners are expected to actively contribute to the vision of the Strengthening Families programme, working collaboratively within a dedicated team to ensure fidelity to its innovative model. This role requires a flexible, trauma-informed, and solution-focused approach, with a strong belief in the capacity for positive change.

Practitioners will work both independently and as part of a team, often in outreach settings, engaging families who face complex challenges. They will provide intensive, bespoke packages of support, helping parents to build resilience, reduce risks, and strengthen relationships. A key aspect of the role involves supporting parents in developing their children’s social and emotional skills, ensuring early development and school readiness.

In addition to child-focused support, practitioners will assist families in broader areas of life including physical and emotional health, safety, education, training, employment, and housing. The ability to work flexibly, including outside standard hours and across different locations, is essential to meet the needs of the service.

Practitioners are expected to maintain accurate and up-to-date records that reflect the voice of the family and demonstrate progress and outcomes. They will apply evidence-based frameworks, such as the Family Partnership Model, to assess and identify family strengths and needs. Regular engagement in reflective practice discussions is encouraged to support team development, build resilience, and maintain healthy professional boundaries.

The role also involves representing the Strengthening Families programme at events, participating in the Community of Practice network, and contributing to a culture of continuous learning. Practitioners will support programme evaluation by conducting regular interviews with families and staying informed about developments in allocated cases to support the wider team.

A strong understanding of child protection and safeguarding procedures is essential, along with the ability to assess and manage risk in line with statutory and local protocols. Overall, this role is suited to individuals who are empathetic, authentic, and committed to making a meaningful difference in the lives of children and families.

**About you**

# **Construction Director at The Crown Estate**

**Purpose of Role**

At The Crown Estate, our purpose is to create lasting and shared prosperity for the nation. As Construction Director, you will provide strategic leadership across a complex portfolio of development projects, ensuring construction activity is delivered safely, sustainably, efficiently and to the highest standards.

Reporting to the Head of Delivery and Programme Management, you will lead the construction agenda across our Urban Development portfolio, shaping delivery strategy, governance, assurance and best practice from early feasibility through to completion and post-project learning. You will play a critical role in protecting long-term asset value, delivering positive outcomes for customers and communities, and embedding our commitment to safety, sustainability and responsible stewardship.

**Context of Opportunity / Main Accountabilities**

This is a rare opportunity to influence some of the UK's most significant and high-profile development activity. Working across a diverse portfolio of projects, you will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including Development, Design, Programme Management, Sustainability, Finance, Legal, Procurement and Health & Safety to ensure exceptional delivery outcomes.

Key responsibilities include:

* Providing leadership for construction delivery across the Urban Development portfolio, establishing strategy, standards, governance and assurance frameworks.
* Championing a best-in-class safety culture, ensuring health, safety and wellbeing remain at the forefront of every project and decision.
* Overseeing programme, cost, risk and quality performance across multiple projects, driving certainty of delivery and proactive risk management.
* Leading construction involvement from feasibility, design and procurement through to commissioning, handover and operational transition.
* Driving effective contractor, consultant and supply chain partnerships that support high-quality, commercially disciplined delivery.
* Embedding sustainable delivery practices, including low-carbon construction, responsible procurement, circular economy principles and social value outcomes.
* Providing clear reporting, assurance and recommendations to senior stakeholders and governance forums to support informed decision making.
* Developing and leading a high-performing team culture built on accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement and inclusion.

**Most Important Skills Based Requirements**

We're looking for a strategic construction leader who can balance long-term stewardship with exceptional delivery focus.

You will bring:

* Significant senior leadership experience within construction, development or major project delivery environments.
* Detailed technical knowledge of how buildings are designed, engineered and constructed, enabling effective oversight of complex development projects, informed decision-making and credible engagement with consultants, contractors and technical specialists.
* A proven track record of delivering large, complex and high-value construction programmes, ideally within commercial, mixed-use, residential, public realm or estate-based developments.
* Demonstrable experience creating and embedding a strong health, safety and wellbeing culture across project portfolios.
* Deep knowledge of UK construction delivery, including regulatory, planning, building safety and CDM requirements.
* Strong commercial and contractual expertise, including procurement strategy, risk management, change control and contract administration.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and aligning a broad range of internal and external stakeholders towards shared outcomes.
* The ability to communicate complex information clearly, influence senior decision makers and provide robust governance and assurance.
* A strong understanding of sustainability, ESG principles, whole-life value and responsible development practices.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, underpinned by a data-led approach to delivery and performance management.
* Relevant professional qualifications (such as MRICS, MCIOB, MAPM, CEng or MICE) or equivalent experience within the built environment are desirable.

As a leader at The Crown Estate, you will be committed to creating environments where people can thrive, fostering trusted partnerships, and delivering outcomes that create lasting value for customers, communities and the country.

**Our Offering / benefits:**

As well as a competitive salary, pension and performance related bonus offering, we have a wealth of benefits available ranging from flexible working; market leading family policies and shopping discounts in the West End, to private healthcare; life and critical illness cover and 28 days holiday with the option to buy more. We value work life balance and your wellbeing highly, enabling you to be your best self to work.

* Help teams choose appropriate technologies for the problem at hand.

* Provide coaching, feedback and day-to-day support.
* Contribute to hiring and onboarding.
* Help create a supportive, inclusive team environment.

**Collaboration and communication**

* Work closely with clients and stakeholders to explain technical decisions clearly.
* Build shared understanding between technical and non-technical colleagues.
* Support teams to work effectively in agile, multidisciplinary ways.
* Help teams navigate ambiguity and unblock delivery.

**Contributing to practice**

Tilt’s mission is simple: **Make Commerce Alive**.

From static store website builders to impersonal marketplaces, today's ecosystem is aging fast. It was built for transactional experiences, not for the new generation of merchants who grow through **attention**, **community** and **personality**.

This isn't a transactional finance job. You'll own the financial data that everything else gets built on - which means you shape how leadership sees the business, too. What the numbers mean. Where the risks sit. Where the opportunities are.
